		internal double? TryGetPotLiquidLevelPercentage()
		{
			double? num = TryGetDoubleValue("PotVolume");
			double? num2 = TryGetDoubleValue("PotLiquidVolume");
			if (!num.HasValue || !num2.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num3 = 100.0 * num2.Value / num.Value;
			if (num3 > 0.0 && num3 < 3.0)
			{
				num3 *= 5.0;
				num3 = ((num3 > 3.0) ? 3.0 : num3);
				num3 = ((num3 < 1.0) ? 1.0 : num3);
			}
			return num3;
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (_sCurBlockPath != null && _sCurBlockPath != BlockPath)
			{
				_sCurBlockPath = BlockPath;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				DisposeOfAllWatches();
			}
			string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = text.LastIndexOf(".Subobjects.");
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, num);
			}
			blockDataPath = text;
			if (iconConfigWatcher == null)
			{
				iconConfigWatcher = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.CreateWatch();
				foreach (string cxsDataPath in cxsDataPaths)
				{
					string text2 = text + cxsDataPath;
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text2))
					{
						iconConfigWatcher.AddWatch(text2, "value");
					}
				}
				iconConfigWatcher.ValuesChanged += iconWatcher_ValuesChanged;
			}
			if (streamsWatcher == null)
			{
				streamsWatcher = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.CreateWatch();
				foreach (StreamInfo item in streamsInfo)
				{
					string text3 = text + item.RCPath;
					streamsWatcher.AddWatch(text3, "value");
				}
				streamsWatcher.ValuesChanged += StreamsConnectDisconnect;
			}
			LoadIcons();
		}

		private void UpdateStreamAnimations_ADS()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				foreach (AnimatedStreamInfo item in animatedStreamsInfo)
				{
					Connection val = SmartIconContainer.FindConnection(item.ConnectionName);
					if (val != null)
					{
						item.UpdateADSInformation(DataProvider);
						if (item.IsFlowing)
						{
							AnimateStream(val);
						}
						else
						{
							StopAnimatingStream(val);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Error updating stream animations." + Environment.NewLine + ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)3);
			}
		}

		private void StopAnimatingStream(Connection connection)
		{
			if (connection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DoubleCollection strokeDashArray = null;
			foreach (Polyline item in ((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)(object)connection).Children.OfType<Polyline>())
			{
				item.StrokeDashArray = strokeDashArray;
				if (item.Tag is Storyboard storyboard)
				{
					storyboard.Stop();
				}
			}
		}

		private void AnimateStream(Connection connection)
		{
			if (connection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Polyline item in ((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)(object)connection).Children.OfType<Polyline>())
			{
				DoubleCollection strokeDashArray = item.StrokeDashArray;
				if (strokeDashArray != null && strokeDashArray.Count > 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				item.StrokeDashArray = dashPattern;
				Storyboard storyboard = null;
				storyboard = StreamFlowAnimation;
				Storyboard.SetTarget(storyboard, item);
				item.Tag = storyboard;
				storyboard.Begin();
			}
		}

		private void StopAnimationsAndSaveFlowsheet()
		{
			System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				try
				{
					simulationIsRunning = false;
					foreach (AnimatedStreamInfo item in animatedStreamsInfo)
					{
						Connection val = SmartIconContainer.FindConnection(item.ConnectionName);
						if (val != null)
						{
							StopAnimatingStream(val);
						}
					}
					CenterAndZoomToFit();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
				}
			}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
		}

		private void LoadIcons()
		{
			try
			{
				if (((MMViewModel)this).View != null && iconConfigWatcher != null && iconConfigWatcher.Values != null && iconConfigWatcher.Values.Length != 0 && !iconConfigWatcher.Values.All((object val) => val == null))
				{
					GetConfigurationInfo();
					ClearTheContainer();
					LoadTemplateIcon();
					if (potOrientation == Orientation.Horizontal || jacketSetting != JacketSetting.FullJacket)
					{
						AddHeatOverlay("Pot");
					}
					AddAnimatedFeedStreams();
					AddHeatTransferIcons();
					if (hasCoils)
					{
						AddHeatOverlay("Coils");
					}
					CenterAndZoomToFit();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private void AddAnimatedFeedStreams()
		{
			try
			{
				animatedStreamsInfo.Clear();
				IEnumerable<Connection> source = SmartIconContainer.Connections.Where((Connection c) => IsAnimatedStream(c));
				while (source.Count() > 0)
				{
					SmartIconContainer.DeleteConnection(source.Last());
				}
				if (streamsWatcher == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				string[] feedStreamsList = GetFeedStreamsList();
				for (int num = 0; num < feedStreamsList.Length; num++)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(feedStreamsList[num]))
					{
						ConnectStream(feedStreamsList[num], streamsInfo[0]);
					}
				}
				for (int num2 = 1; num2 < streamsWatcher.Values.Length; num2++)
				{
					object obj = streamsWatcher.Values[num2];
					if (obj != null)
					{
						string text = obj.ToString();
						if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
						{
							ConnectStream(text, streamsInfo[num2]);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				string text2 = "Failed to add feed streams." + Environment.NewLine;
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text2 + ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private void ConnectStream(string streamName, StreamInfo streamInfo)
		{
			try
			{
				string text = $"Unable to find target port {streamInfo.PortType.ToString()} for feed stream.";
				Port potPort = GetPotPort(streamInfo.PortType);
				if (potPort == null)
				{
					SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
					return;
				}
				int num = ((streamInfo.PortType == PotPort.Vent) ? 50 : 100);
				string text2 = streamName.Replace("-", "_1");
				text2 = text2.Replace("+", "_2");
				text2 = "AnimatedStream_" + text2;
				bool flag = streamInfo.PortType == PotPort.Input;
				Connection obj = SmartIconContainer.Connect(flag ? null : potPort, flag ? potPort : null, false, (double)num, true, "Black", 1.0, "", "", "");
				obj.SetName(text2);
				obj.AddLabel(streamName, 10);
				AnimatedStreamInfo item = new AnimatedStreamInfo(text2, streamInfo.GetADSPaths(streamName), streamName);
				animatedStreamsInfo.Add(item);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				string text3 = "Failed to connect a feed stream: '" + streamName + "'." + Environment.NewLine;
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text3 + ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private Port GetPotPort(PotPort port)
		{
			string text = "Unable to find port for charge stream; target icon was missing or had no ports.";
			Port result = null;
			IconCtrl val = FindIcon("Pot");
			if (val == null || val.Ports == null)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
				return null;
			}
			switch (port)
			{
			case PotPort.Input:
				result = val.FindPort("ChargeStream");
				break;
			case PotPort.Filter:
				result = val.FindPort("Filter");
				break;
			case PotPort.Draw:
				result = val.FindPort("Draw");
				break;
			case PotPort.Vent:
				result = val.FindPort("Vent");
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void GetConfigurationInfo()
		{
			if (iconConfigWatcher == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object[] values = iconConfigWatcher.Values;
			if (values == null || values.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				bool ignoreCase = true;
				potOrientation = Orientation.Vertical;
				object obj = values[0];
				if (obj != null)
				{
					potOrientation = (Orientation)Enum.Parse(typeof(Orientation), obj.ToString(), ignoreCase);
				}
				jacketSetting = JacketSetting.NoJacket;
				coilsSetting = CoilsSetting.NoCoils;
				hasJacket = false;
				hasCoils = false;
				object obj2 = values[8];
				if (obj2 != null && obj2.ToString().ToUpper() == "RIGOROUS")
				{
					int result = -1;
					int result2 = -1;
					int.TryParse(values[1].ToString(), out result);
					int.TryParse(values[2].ToString(), out result2);
					jacketHeating = result == 1;
					jacketCooling = result2 == 1;
					hasJacket = jacketHeating || jacketCooling;
					if (potOrientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
					{
						hasJacket = false;
					}
					if (hasJacket)
					{
						bool flag = (int)values[3] == 1;
						jacketSetting = ((!flag) ? JacketSetting.PartialJacket : JacketSetting.FullJacket);
					}
					int result3 = -1;
					int result4 = -1;
					int.TryParse(values[4].ToString(), out result3);
					int.TryParse(values[5].ToString(), out result4);
					coilHeating = result3 == 1;
					coilCooling = result4 == 1;
					hasCoils = coilHeating || coilCooling;
					if (hasCoils)
					{
						coilsSetting = CoilsSetting.Coils;
					}
				}
				validPhases = ValidPhases.VaporLiquidLiquid;
				object obj3 = values[6];
				string text = null;
				if (obj3 != null)
				{
					text = obj3.ToString();
				}
				if ((!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) && string.Equals(text, "VL", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)) || (int.TryParse(text, out var result5) && result5 == 2))
				{
					object obj4 = values[7];
					string a = null;
					if (obj4 != null)
					{
						a = obj4.ToString();
					}
					if (string.Equals(a, "NO", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						validPhases = ValidPhases.VaporLiquid;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private void SaveHeatOverlayValues()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View != null)
			{
				hInfo = new HeatOverlayInfo
				{
					BottomTemperature = GetIconAnimationValue("PotHeatOverlay", "BottomColor"),
					JacketMode = ((hasJacket && potOrientation == Orientation.Vertical) ? GetIconAnimationValue(jacketSetting.ToString() + "HeatOverlay", "OverlayColor") : null),
					CoilsMode = (hasCoils ? GetIconAnimationValue("CoilsHeatOverlay", "OverlayColor") : null)
				};
			}
		}

				stringBuilder.Append(value);
				if (underlyingIconName == "Pot" || underlyingIconName == "Coils")

				{
					return;
				}
				double num = default(double);
				double num2 = default(double);
				double num3 = default(double);
				val.GetPosition(ref num, ref num2, ref num3);
				IconCtrl val2 = SmartIconContainer.LoadIcon(xmlDocument, num, num2, num3, (XmlNamespaceManager)null);

		private void DeleteLiquidLevelIcons()
		{
			IEnumerable<IconCtrl> source = SmartIconContainer.Icons.Where((IconCtrl icon) => ((FrameworkElement)(object)icon).Name.EndsWith("LiquidLevel", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) || ((FrameworkElement)(object)icon).Name.EndsWith("LiquidLevel2", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase));
			while (source.Count() > 0)
			{
				SmartIconContainer.DeleteIcon(source.Last());
			}
		}

		{

		private void PostLoadFlowsheet()
		{
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0080: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				AddLiquidLevels();
			}
			UpdateIconOverlays_ADS();
			foreach (IconCtrl icon in SmartIconContainer.Icons)

				((UIElement)(object)icon).MouseEnter -= Icon_MouseEnterEvent;
				((UIElement)(object)icon).MouseLeave -= Icon_MouseLeaveEvent;
				icon.IconEditorEvent += new IconEditorEventHandler(Icon_IconEditorEvent);
				((UIElement)(object)icon).MouseEnter += Icon_MouseEnterEvent;
				((UIElement)(object)icon).MouseLeave += Icon_MouseLeaveEvent;
				TextBlock tip = new TextBlock();
				string overlaysTargetIconName = GetOverlaysTargetIconName(((FrameworkElement)(object)icon).Name);
				tip.Text = GetToolTipForIcon(overlaysTargetIconName);
				((FrameworkElement)(object)icon).ToolTip = tip;
				icon.Ports.ForEach(delegate(Port port)
				{
					((FrameworkElement)(object)port).ToolTip = tip;
				});
			}
			((UIElement)(object)SmartIconContainer).MouseRightButtonUp += SmartIconContainer_MouseRightButtonUp;
		}

		internal void InitializeIconDisplay()
		{
			CheckIfUseAnimation();
			int num = MmgSor.MMinqrsl();

			if (savedFlowsheet == null || _sCurBlockPath == null || _sCurBlockPath != BlockPath)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
				LoadIcons();
			}
			else
			{
				GetConfigurationInfo();
				LoadSavedFlowsheet();
				PostLoadFlowsheet();
			}
			_sCurBlockPath = BlockPath;
		}

			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationRunFailedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationRunFailedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SimulationRunFailedEventArgs>)OnSimulationRunFailedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<ObjectRenamedAnywhereEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<ObjectRenamedAnywhereEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<ObjectRenamedAnywhereEventArgs>)OnObjectRenameEvent);
		}

		private void UnsubscribeFromAggregatedEvents()
		{
			IEventAggregator obj = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());

			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationIntegrationStepEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs>)OnSimulationIntegrationStepEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationRunPausedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationRunPausedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SimulationRunPausedEventArgs>)OnSimulationRunPausedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationRunCompletedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationRunCompletedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SimulationRunCompletedEventArgs>)OnSimulationRunCompletedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationRunFailedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationRunFailedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SimulationRunFailedEventArgs>)OnSimulationRunFailedEvent);

		}

		private void OnObjectRenameEvent(ObjectRenamedAnywhereEventArgs args)
		{
			if (args == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(args.OldName) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(args.NewName))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (args.IsCxsPathImpacted(_sCurBlockPath))
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				if (_sCurBlockPath != BlockPath)
				{
					_sCurBlockPath = BlockPath;
					DisposeOfAllWatches();
					((CxvViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
					LoadIcons();
				}
			}
			if (!args.OldPath.Contains("Streams"))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = _sCurBlockPath.Contains("Data");
			bool flag2 = args.OldPath.Contains("Data");
			bool flag3 = false;
			if (!flag && !flag2)
			{
				flag3 = true;
			}
			else if (flag && flag2)
			{
				string[] array = _sCurBlockPath.Split('.');
				string[] array2 = args.OldPath.Split('.');
				if (array[1] == array2[1])
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag3)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < streamsWatcher.Values.Length; i++)
			{
				if (streamsWatcher.Values[i] != null && streamsWatcher.Values[i].ToString() == args.OldName)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.BatchSet(blockDataPath + streamsInfo[i].RCPath, "value", (string)null, (object)args.NewName);
					return;
				}
			}
			string[] feedStreamsList = GetFeedStreamsList();
			if (feedStreamsList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag4 = false;
			for (int j = 0; j < feedStreamsList.Length; j++)
			{
				if (feedStreamsList[j] == args.OldName)
				{
					feedStreamsList[j] = args.NewName;
					flag4 = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag4)
			{
				return;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(181);
			string[] array3 = feedStreamsList;
			foreach (string value in array3)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(value);
					stringBuilder.Append('*');
				}
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.BatchSet(blockDataPath + ".Input.FEED_STRM", "value", (string)null, (object)stringBuilder.ToString());
		}

		private void OnSimulationRunStartedEvent(SimulationRunStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			CheckIfUseAnimation();
			animationsEnabled = true;
			simulationIsRunning = true;
		}

		private void OnSimulationIntegrationStepEvent(SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs e)
		{
			animationsEnabled = true;

		}

		private void UpdateVisualsDuringRun()
		{
			if (!useAnimation || !animationsEnabled || !simulationIsRunning)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (!(((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchOp_Flowsheet))
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					UpdateIconOverlays_ADS();
					UpdateStreamAnimations_ADS();
					SaveHeatOverlayValues();
					SaveFlowsheet();

		private void cxsCase_MessageHandler(object sender, CxsMessageEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (CxsMessage message in e.Messages)
			{
				CxsMessage current = message;
				if ((int)((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageType == 0)
				{
					string text = ((CxsMessage)(ref current)).Text;
					if (text.StartsWith("Initialization as Empty completed.") || text.StartsWith("Initialization at Total reflux completed successfully") || text.StartsWith("Initialization completed successfully"))
					{
						UpdateVisualsDuringRun();
					}
					else if (text.StartsWith("The run has completed"))
					{
						StopAnimationsAndSaveFlowsheet();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckIfUseAnimation()

		private void UpdateIconOverlays()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				UpdateTemperatureProfile();
				UpdateLiquidLevels();
				if (hasJacket && potOrientation == Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					UpdateHeatTransferColor("JacketHeatOverlay");
				}
				if (hasCoils)
				{
					UpdateHeatTransferColor("CoilsHeatOverlay");
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Error updating icon overlays." + Environment.NewLine + ex, (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTemperatureProfile()
		{
			IconCtrl val = FindIcon("PotHeatOverlay");
			if (val != null)
			{
				string eODouble = GetEODouble("T(1)");
				string eODouble2 = GetEODouble("T(2)");
				if (double.TryParse(eODouble, out var result) && double.TryParse(eODouble2, out var result2))
				{
					double num = 25.0;
					double num2 = 125.0;
					double num3 = num2 - num;
					double num4 = 0.3;
					double num5 = Math.Max(num, Math.Min(num2, result));
					double num6 = Math.Max(num, Math.Min(num2, result2));
					int num7 = (int)(255.0 * (num6 - num) / num3);
					Color color = new Color
					{
						A = (byte)(255.0 * num4),
						R = (byte)num7,
						B = (byte)(255 - num7)
					};
					int num8 = (int)(255.0 * (num5 - num) / num3);
					Color color2 = new Color
					{
						A = (byte)(255.0 * num4),
						R = (byte)num8,
						B = (byte)(255 - num8)
					};
					val.SetAnimationValue("BottomColor", color2.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateHeatTransferColor(string iconName)
		{
			IconCtrl val = SmartIconContainer.Icons.Find((IconCtrl i) => ((FrameworkElement)(object)i).Name != null && ((FrameworkElement)(object)i).Name.EndsWith(iconName));
			if (val != null)
			{
				string variableName = string.Empty;
				if (iconName.StartsWith("HX"))
				{
					variableName = "Pot.HeatTransfer.HTModeExtHX";
				}
				else if (iconName.StartsWith("Coils"))
				{
					variableName = "Pot.HeatTransfer.HTModeCoils";
				}
				else if (iconName.StartsWith("Jacket"))
				{
					variableName = "Pot.HeatTransfer.HTModeJacket";
				}
				if (double.TryParse(GetEODouble(variableName), out var result))
				{
					double num = 0.4;
					Color color = ((result != 1.0) ? Brushes.Blue.Color : Brushes.Red.Color);
					color.A = (byte)(255.0 * num);
					val.SetAnimationValue("OverlayColor", color.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
			}
		}

		[Conditional("USE_ADS")]
		private void UpdateIconOverlays_ADS()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View == null || !animationsEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				bool success = false;
				UpdateTemperatureProfile_ADS(ref success);
				UpdateLiquidLevels();
				double? num = null;
				if (hasJacket && potOrientation == Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					if (jacketHeating)
					{
						num = ((!jacketCooling) ? new double?(1.0) : DataProvider.TryGetJacketMode());
					}
					else if (jacketCooling)
					{
						num = 0.0;
					}
					UpdateHeatTransferColor_ADS("JacketHeatOverlay", success ? num : new double?(-1.0));
				}
				if (hasCoils)
				{
					if (coilHeating)
					{
						num = ((!coilCooling) ? new double?(1.0) : DataProvider.TryGetCoilsMode());
					}
					else if (coilCooling)
					{
						num = 0.0;
					}
					UpdateHeatTransferColor_ADS("CoilsHeatOverlay", success ? num : new double?(-1.0));
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Error updating icon overlays." + Environment.NewLine + ex, (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		[Conditional("USE_ADS")]
		private void UpdateTemperatureProfile_ADS(ref bool success)
		{
			IconCtrl val = FindIcon("PotHeatOverlay");
			if (val != null)
			{
				double? num = DataProvider.TryGetPotTemperature();
				double num2 = 25.0;
				double num3 = 125.0;
				double num4 = num3 - num2;
				double num5 = 0.3;
				double num6 = 273.15;
				int num7 = 0;
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					success = true;
					double num8 = Math.Max(num2, Math.Min(num3, num.Value - num6));
					num7 = (int)(255.0 * (num8 - num2) / num4);
				}
				else
				{
					num5 = 0.0;
				}
				val.SetAnimationValue("BottomColor", new Color
				{
					A = (byte)(255.0 * num5),
					R = (byte)num7,
					B = (byte)(255 - num7)
				}.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			}
		}

		private void UpdateLiquidLevels()
		{
			if (animationsEnabled)
			{
				UpdateLiquidLevel_ADS();
			}
		}

		[Conditional("USE_ADS")]
		private void UpdateLiquidLevel_ADS()
		{
			string iconName = "PotLiquidLevel";
			double? num = DataProvider.TryGetPotLiquidLevelPercentage();
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				FindIcon(iconName)?.SetAnimationValue("LiquidLevel", Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(100.0, num.Value)).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			}
		}

		[Conditional("USE_ADS")]
		private void UpdateHeatTransferColor_ADS(string iconName, double? mode)
		{
			IconCtrl val = SmartIconContainer.Icons.Find((IconCtrl i) => ((FrameworkElement)(object)i).Name != null && ((FrameworkElement)(object)i).Name.EndsWith(iconName));
			if (val != null)
			{
				double num = 0.4;
				Color color;
				if (mode == 1.0)
				{
					color = Colors.Red;
					color.A = (byte)(255.0 * num);
				}
				else if (mode == 0.0)
				{
					color = Colors.Blue;
					color.A = (byte)(255.0 * num);
				}
				else
				{
					color = Colors.Transparent;
				}
				val.SetAnimationValue("OverlayColor", color.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			}
		}

		private string GetEODouble(string variableName)
		{
			string eOBlockVariables = EOVariableUtils.GetEOBlockVariables(BlockName, variableName);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(eOBlockVariables))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] array = eOBlockVariables.Split(new string[2] { "\n", "=" }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = array[1];
			if (!double.TryParse(text, out var _))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string GetOverlaysTargetIconName(string baseIconName)
		{
			string result = baseIconName;
			int val = baseIconName.IndexOf("HeatOverlay");
			int val2 = baseIconName.IndexOf("LiquidLevel");
			int num = Math.Max(val, val2);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				result = baseIconName.Substring(0, num);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string GetIconAnimationValue(string iconName, string key)
		{
			return FindIcon(iconName)?.GetAnimationValue(key);
		}

		private IconCtrl FindIcon(string iconName)
		{
			IconCtrl obj = SmartIconContainer.FindIcon(iconName);
			string text = "Unable to find icon '" + iconName + "'.";
			if (obj == null)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text, (Category)3, (Priority)3);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private void DisposeOfAllWatches()
		{
			if (iconConfigWatcher != null)
			{
				iconConfigWatcher.ValuesChanged -= iconWatcher_ValuesChanged;
				iconConfigWatcher.Unload();
				iconConfigWatcher = null;
			}
			if (streamsWatcher != null)
			{
				streamsWatcher.ValuesChanged -= StreamsConnectDisconnect;
				streamsWatcher.ValuesChanged -= StreamsConnectDisconnect;
				streamsWatcher.Unload();
				streamsWatcher = null;
			}
		}

		public override void Unload()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View != null)
			{
				ClearTheContainer();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).Unload();
			DisposeOfAllWatches();
			UnsubscribeFromAggregatedEvents();
			UnsubscribeFromCXSCaseMessages();
		}

		private void DumpFlowsheet()
		{
			string innerXml = SmartIconContainer.Save().InnerXml;
			string text = "C:\\temp";
			if (!Directory.Exists(text))
			{
				Directory.CreateDirectory(text);
			}
			string text2 = DateTime.Now.ToString("MMddHHmmss");
			File.WriteAllText(System.IO.Path.Combine(text, "bsflowsheet_" + text2 + ".xml"), innerXml);
		}
	}

		Double,

	internal class AnimatedStreamInfo
	{
		private static double flowThreshold = 0.0001;

		private string[] ADSVariables;

		private string streamName;

		private string connectionName;

		private bool isFlowing;

		internal string StreamName => streamName;

		internal string ConnectionName => connectionName;

		internal bool IsFlowing => isFlowing;

		internal void UpdateADSInformation(BatchOpFlowsheetDataProvider dataProvider)
		{
			if (ADSVariables == null)
			{
				isFlowing = false;
				return;
			}
			string[] aDSVariables = ADSVariables;
			foreach (string path in aDSVariables)
			{
				double? streamFlow = dataProvider.GetStreamFlow(path);
				if (streamFlow.HasValue)
				{
					isFlowing = streamFlow.Value > flowThreshold;
					if (isFlowing)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal AnimatedStreamInfo(string streamName, string[] ADSVariables, string cxsPath)
		{
			this.ADSVariables = ADSVariables;
			connectionName = streamName;
			this.streamName = cxsPath;
		}
	}
	internal class StreamInfo
	{
		private string rcPath;

		private string[] baseADSPaths;

		private ADSVariableType adsVariableType;

		private PotPort portType;

		public string RCPath => rcPath;

		public PotPort PortType => portType;

		public StreamInfo(string rcPath, string adsPath, ADSVariableType adsVariableType, PotPort portType)
		{
			this.rcPath = rcPath;
			this.adsVariableType = adsVariableType;
			switch (adsVariableType)
			{
			case ADSVariableType.Double:
				baseADSPaths = new string[1] { adsPath };
				break;
			case ADSVariableType.StreamArray:
				baseADSPaths = new string[2]
				{
					string.Format(adsPath, "{0}", "MIXED"),
					string.Format(adsPath, "{0}", "CISOLID")
				};
				break;
			}
			this.portType = portType;
		}

		public string[] GetADSPaths(string streamName)
		{
			string[] result = null;
			if (adsVariableType == ADSVariableType.Double)
			{
				result = new string[1] { baseADSPaths[0] };
			}
			else if (adsVariableType == ADSVariableType.StreamArray)
			{
				result = new string[2]
				{
					string.Format(baseADSPaths[0], streamName),
					string.Format(baseADSPaths[1], streamName)
				};
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		private void Case_Message(object sender, CxsMessageEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_006d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0073: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00c0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c6: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0113: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0119: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0166: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			foreach (CxsMessage message in e.Messages)
			{
				CxsMessage current = message;
				if ((int)((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageType == 3)
				{
					if (UIDispatcher == null || Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher == UIDispatcher)
					{
						IsSimulating = true;
						OnSimulationRunStarted();
						continue;
					}
					UIDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
					{
						IsSimulating = true;
						OnSimulationRunStarted();
					});
				}
				else if ((int)((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageType == 7)
				{
					if (UIDispatcher == null || Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher == UIDispatcher)
					{
						IsSimulating = false;
						OnSimulationRunPaused();
						continue;
					}
					UIDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
					{
						IsSimulating = false;
						OnSimulationRunPaused();
					});
				}
				else if ((int)((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageType == 4)
				{
					if (UIDispatcher == null || Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher == UIDispatcher)
					{
						IsSimulating = false;
						OnSimulationRunFailed();
						continue;
					}
					UIDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
					{
						IsSimulating = false;
						OnSimulationRunFailed();
					});
				}
				else if ((int)((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageType == 5)
				{
					if (UIDispatcher == null || Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher == UIDispatcher)
					{
						IsSimulating = false;
						OnSimulationRunCompleted();
						continue;
					}
					UIDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
					{
						IsSimulating = false;
						OnSimulationRunCompleted();
					});
				}
				else
				{
					if ((int)((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageType != 13)
					{
						continue;
					}
					switch (((CxsMessage)(ref current)).Number)
					{
					case 1373:
						if (UIDispatcher == null || Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher == UIDispatcher)
						{
							OnSimulationIntegrationStep();
							break;
						}
						UIDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
						{
							OnSimulationIntegrationStep();
						});
						break;
					case 1005:
						if (((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageDataCount <= 0 || Convert.ToInt32(((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageData[0]) != 109)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (UIDispatcher == null || Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher == UIDispatcher)
						{
							OnSimulationReinitialized();
							break;
						}
						UIDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
						{
							OnSimulationReinitialized();
						});
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

			{

		private void ShowReactorWatcher_ValuesChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ChangeReactorVisibility(showReactorWatcher.Values[0]);
			ChangeVisibilityEnabled(showReactorWatcher.Values[1]);
		}

		private void ChangeVisibilityEnabled(object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				string text = value.ToString();
				if (text == "0")
				{
					BatchOpUISetup.IsReactorDisplayEnabled = false;
				}
				else if (text == "1")
				{
					BatchOpUISetup.IsReactorDisplayEnabled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ChangeReactorVisibility(object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (value.ToString() == "1")
				{
					BatchOpUISetup.IsReactorDisplayed = true;
				}
				else
				{
					BatchOpUISetup.IsReactorDisplayed = false;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class BatchOpFlowsheetTemplate : BatchOpTabTemplate
	{
		private GridSplitter gridSplitter;

		private double lastMaxWidth;

		private GridLength lastWidth = new GridLength(30.0, GridUnitType.Star);

		private bool isDisplayed;

		protected bool GetBatchOpFlowSheetDisplayState()
		{
			return isDisplayed;
		}

		public BatchOpFlowsheetTemplate()
		{
			base.SideContent = new MMBatchOp_Flowsheet();
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Loaded += BatchOpFlowsheetTemplate_Loaded;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Unloaded += BatchOpFlowsheetTemplate_Unloaded;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).SizeChanged += BatchOpFlowsheetTemplate_SizeChanged;
		}

		public bool HideBatchOpFlowsheet()
		{
			ColumnDefinition flowsheetColumn = GetFlowsheetColumn();
			if (flowsheetColumn == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			lastMaxWidth = flowsheetColumn.MaxWidth;
			lastWidth = flowsheetColumn.Width;
			Grid mainGrid = GetMainGrid();
			mainGrid.InvalidateArrange();
			mainGrid.UpdateLayout();
			ResizeFlowsheet(new Size(0.0, ((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Height));
			isDisplayed = false;
			return true;
		}

		public bool ShowBatchOpFlowsheet()
		{
			ColumnDefinition flowsheetColumn = GetFlowsheetColumn();
			if (flowsheetColumn == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			flowsheetColumn.Width = lastWidth;
			isDisplayed = true;
			lastMaxWidth = ((lastMaxWidth == 0.0) ? (((FrameworkElement)(object)this).ActualWidth * 0.75) : lastMaxWidth);
			ResizeFlowsheet(new Size(lastMaxWidth / 0.75, ((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Height));
			Grid mainGrid = GetMainGrid();
			mainGrid.InvalidateArrange();
			mainGrid.UpdateLayout();
			ResizeFlowsheet(new Size(lastMaxWidth / 0.75, ((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Height));
			return true;
		}

		public bool ToggleFlowsheetVisibility()
		{
			if (isDisplayed)
			{
				HideBatchOpFlowsheet();
			}
			else
			{
				ShowBatchOpFlowsheet();
			}
			return isDisplayed;
		}

		protected virtual void ChangeReactorDisplayStatus(bool isVisible)
		{
			if (isVisible && !isDisplayed)
			{
				ShowBatchOpFlowsheet();
			}
			else if (!isVisible && isDisplayed)
			{
				HideBatchOpFlowsheet();
			}
		}

		private void BatchOpFlowsheetTemplate_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ControlTemplate template = ((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)this).Template;
			if (template != null)
			{
				SetMaximumFlowsheetWidth(new Size(((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Width, ((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Height));
				if (template.FindName("Splitter", (FrameworkElement)(object)this) is GridSplitter gridSplitter)
				{
					this.gridSplitter = gridSplitter;
					this.gridSplitter.DragCompleted += splitter_DragCompleted;
				}
				((UIElement)(object)this).MouseRightButtonUp += BatchOpFlowsheetTemplate_MouseRightButtonUp;
				BatchOpUISetup.OnReactorDisplayedChange += ChangeReactorDisplayStatus;
				isDisplayed = true;
				if (!BatchOpUISetup.IsReactorDisplayed)
				{
					HideBatchOpFlowsheet();
				}
				else
				{
					ShowBatchOpFlowsheet();
				}
			}
		}

		private void BatchOpFlowsheetTemplate_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			((UIElement)(object)this).MouseRightButtonUp -= BatchOpFlowsheetTemplate_MouseRightButtonUp;
			BatchOpUISetup.OnReactorDisplayedChange -= ChangeReactorDisplayStatus;
			if (((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)this).Template != null && gridSplitter != null)
			{
				gridSplitter.DragCompleted -= splitter_DragCompleted;
			}
		}

		private void BatchOpFlowsheetTemplate_MouseRightButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OriginalSource is Visual reference && VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(reference) is MMBatchOp_Flowsheet)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void SetMaximumFlowsheetWidth(Size newSize)
		{
			ColumnDefinition flowsheetColumn = GetFlowsheetColumn();
			if (flowsheetColumn != null)
			{
				double num = (double.IsNaN(newSize.Width) ? ((FrameworkElement)(object)this).ActualWidth : newSize.Width);
				num = ((num > 0.0) ? num : 1.0);
				flowsheetColumn.MaxWidth = num * 0.75;
			}
		}

		private ColumnDefinition GetFlowsheetColumn()
		{
			Grid mainGrid = GetMainGrid();
			if (mainGrid == null || mainGrid.ColumnDefinitions == null || mainGrid.ColumnDefinitions.Count() == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return mainGrid.ColumnDefinitions.Last();
		}

		private Grid GetMainGrid()
		{
			ControlTemplate template = ((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)this).Template;
			if (template == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return template.FindName("MainGrid", (FrameworkElement)(object)this) as Grid;
		}

		private void BatchOpFlowsheetTemplate_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (gridSplitter != null && !gridSplitter.IsDragging && !e.Handled)
			{
				ResizeFlowsheet(e.NewSize);
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void splitter_DragCompleted(object sender, DragCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				ResizeFlowsheet(new Size(((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Width, ((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Height));
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void ResizeFlowsheet(Size newSize)
		{
			if (isDisplayed && base.SideContent is MMBatchOp_Flowsheet mMBatchOp_Flowsheet)
			{
				SetMaximumFlowsheetWidth(newSize);
				mMBatchOp_Flowsheet.ResizeSmartIconContainer();
				((UIElement)(object)mMBatchOp_Flowsheet).Opacity = ((newSize.Width != 0.0) ? 1 : 0);
			}
		}

		public override bool OnClosing()
		{
			bool result = ((MMTabTemplate)this).OnClosing();
			if (gridSplitter != null)
			{
				gridSplitter.DragCompleted -= splitter_DragCompleted;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

				return false;

					BatchOpUISetup.OnReactorDisplayedChange?.Invoke(value);

				}
				isReactorDisplayEnabled = value;
			}
		}

	}

		private void ClearAllData()
		{
			SubStreamsCollection.Clear();
			UnitOptions.Clear();
			MassMoleCollection.Clear();
			SubStreams_Selected = string.Empty;
			MassMole_Selected = string.Empty;
			GlobalUnit_Selected = string.Empty;
			_view.grdComRates.Fields.Clear();
			_view.grdComRates.UpdateDataGrid();
		}

		private void SetDefaultValue()
		{
			string parentElementPath = "@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.#0.SSCompGenerateRates";
			IEnumerable<string> elementCollection = GetElementCollection(parentElementPath);
			SubStreamsCollection.Clear();
			if (elementCollection != null)
			{
				foreach (string item in elementCollection)
				{
					SubStreamsCollection.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (_subStreamsCollection != null && _subStreamsCollection.Count() >= 1)
			{
				SubStreams_Selected = _subStreamsCollection.ToList().FirstOrDefault();
				MassMoleCollection.Clear();
				if (!SubStreams_Selected.ToString().ToUpper().StartsWith("NC"))
				{
					MassMoleCollection.Add(_strMole);
				}
				MassMoleCollection.Add(_strMass);
				MassMole_Selected = MassMoleCollection.FirstOrDefault();
			}
		}

		private void SetLableForRplug()
		{
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main", "type")).Equals("Rplug", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) && _view != null)
			{
				((AesLabel)_view.ratesLable).Content = BatchProcessResources.MMBatchOP_ProFileResult_CompRates_CompRatesLable_Bplug;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetElementCollection(string parentElementPath)
		{
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, parentElementPath, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val == null || !val.success)

			}
		}

		private void ResetUnitForField()
		{
			if (_view.grdComRates.Fields.Count <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < _view.grdComRates.Fields.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_view.grdComRates.Fields[i].CurrentHeaderUnits != _globalUnit_Selected)
				{
					_view.grdComRates.Fields[i].CurrentHeaderUnits = _globalUnit_Selected;
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitialGolbalUnit()
		{
			if (_view.grdComRates.Fields.Count <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			UnitOptions.Clear();
			AdsField val = _view.grdComRates.Fields[1];
			if (val.HeaderUnitsList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (string headerUnits in val.HeaderUnitsList)
			{
				UnitOptions.Add(headerUnits);
			}
			GlobalUnit_Selected = val.CurrentHeaderUnits;
		}

		{
			//IL_006b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0197: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01bc: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (_subStreams_Selected == null || _massMole_Selected == null || _view == null || _view.grdComRates == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string parentElementPath = $"@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.#0.SSCompGenerateRates.@SubStream.@MassMole";

			_view.grdComRates.Fields.Clear();

				DataAttribute = "value",
				Width = 100.0

				val.Label = BatchProcessResources.MMBatchOP_ProFileResult_AdsTime;
				val.PropertyPath = "@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.@rowid.time";
			}
			else

				val.PropertyPath = "@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.@rowid.length";
			}

	internal class ConcentrationAdsVariablesProvider
	{
		private readonly List<ProfileADSConcentrationVariableTemplate> _adsVariablesTemplates = new List<ProfileADSConcentrationVariableTemplate>
		{
			new ProfileADSConcentrationVariableTemplate("L_CON_MAEQ", ApwnResources.MMRBatch_Profil_Concentration_MMFHeader1, tryAppendComponentName: true),
			new ProfileADSConcentrationVariableTemplate("L_CON_MANE", ApwnResources.MMRBatch_Profil_Concentration_MMFHeader2, tryAppendComponentName: true),
			new ProfileADSConcentrationVariableTemplate("L_CON_MOEQ", ApwnResources.MMRBatch_Profil_Concentration_MMFHeader1, tryAppendComponentName: true),
			new ProfileADSConcentrationVariableTemplate("L_CON_MONE", ApwnResources.MMRBatch_Profil_Concentration_MMFHeader2, tryAppendComponentName: true)
		};

		internal List<ProfileADSConcentrationVariable> GetVariables(IEnumerable<string> allProfileVariables)
		{
			if (allProfileVariables == null || allProfileVariables.Count() <= 0)
			{
				return new List<ProfileADSConcentrationVariable>();
			}
			List<string> list = allProfileVariables.ToList();
			List<ProfileADSConcentrationVariable> list2 = new List<ProfileADSConcentrationVariable>(list.Count);
			Stack<int> stack = new Stack<int>(list.Count);
			foreach (ProfileADSConcentrationVariableTemplate adsVariablesTemplate in _adsVariablesTemplates)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					string text = list[i];
					if (text.StartsWith(adsVariablesTemplate.AdsKeyName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
					{
						list2.Add(GetConcentrationAdsVariable(text, adsVariablesTemplate));
						stack.Push(i);
					}
				}
				while (stack.Count > 0)
				{
					list.RemoveAt(stack.Pop());
				}
			}
			return list2;
		}

		private static ProfileADSConcentrationVariable GetConcentrationAdsVariable(string completeADSName, ProfileADSConcentrationVariableTemplate template)
		{
			string text = template.DescriptionTemplate;
			if (template.TryAppendComponentName)
			{
				string text2 = completeADSName.Split('_')?.LastOrDefault();
				text = (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text2) ? text : (text + " " + text2));
			}
			return new ProfileADSConcentrationVariable(completeADSName, text);
		}
	}
	internal readonly struct ProfileADSConcentrationVariableTemplate
	{
		internal readonly string AdsKeyName;

		internal readonly string DescriptionTemplate;

		internal readonly bool TryAppendComponentName;

		internal ProfileADSConcentrationVariableTemplate(string adsKeyName, string descriptionTemplate, bool tryAppendComponentName = false)
		{
			AdsKeyName = adsKeyName;
			DescriptionTemplate = descriptionTemplate;
			TryAppendComponentName = tryAppendComponentName;
		}
	}
	internal class ProfileADSConcentrationVariable
	{
		internal string AdsName { get; private set; }

		internal string Description { get; private set; }

		internal ProfileADSConcentrationVariable(string adsName, string description)
		{
			AdsName = adsName;
			Description = description;
		}
	}

		private string GetLocalizedColumnHeader(string propertyName, string componentID = null)
		{

			}

			if (text != null && text.Contains("{0}"))
			{
				text = ((componentID == null) ? null : string.Format(text, componentID));
			}
			return text;
		}

		private bool TryGetAdsPropertyInfo(string propertyName, out AdsPropertyInfo adsPropertyInfo)
		{
			foreach (AdsPropertyInfo adsProperty in _adsProperties)
			{
				if (propertyName == adsProperty.PropertyName)
				{
					adsPropertyInfo = adsProperty;
					return true;
				}
			}
			adsPropertyInfo = AdsPropertyInfo.Empty;
			return false;
		}

	internal readonly struct AdsPropertyInfo : IComparable<AdsPropertyInfo>
	{
		internal static readonly AdsPropertyInfo Empty = new AdsPropertyInfo(int.MaxValue, string.Empty, string.Empty);

		internal readonly string PropertyName;

		internal readonly int DisplayOrder;

		internal readonly string LocalizedValue;

		internal AdsPropertyInfo(int displayOrder, string propertyName, string localizedValue)
		{
			DisplayOrder = displayOrder;
			PropertyName = propertyName;
			LocalizedValue = localizedValue;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(AdsPropertyInfo propertyData, string value)
		{
			return propertyData.Equals(value);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(string value, AdsPropertyInfo propertyData)
		{
			return propertyData.Equals(value);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(AdsPropertyInfo propertyData, string value)
		{
			return !propertyData.Equals(value);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(string value, AdsPropertyInfo propertyData)
		{
			return !propertyData.Equals(value);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(AdsPropertyInfo data1, AdsPropertyInfo data2)
		{
			return data1.Equals(data2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(AdsPropertyInfo data1, AdsPropertyInfo data2)
		{
			return !data1.Equals(data2);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is AdsPropertyInfo adsPropertyInfo)
			{
				if (DisplayOrder == adsPropertyInfo.DisplayOrder)
				{
					return adsPropertyInfo == PropertyName;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (obj is string b)
			{
				return string.Equals(PropertyName, b, StringComparison.Ordinal);
			}
			return base.Equals(obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return DisplayOrder;
		}

		public int CompareTo(AdsPropertyInfo other)
		{
			return DisplayOrder.CompareTo(other.DisplayOrder);
		}

		internal List<ProfileADSFermenVariable> GetVariables(IEnumerable<string> allProfileVariables)
		{
			if (allProfileVariables == null || allProfileVariables.Count() <= 0)
			{
				return new List<ProfileADSFermenVariable>();
			}
			List<string> list = allProfileVariables.ToList();
			List<ProfileADSFermenVariable> list2 = new List<ProfileADSFermenVariable>(list.Count);
			Stack<int> stack = new Stack<int>(list.Count);
			foreach (ProfileADSFermenVariableTemplate adsVariablesTemplate in _adsVariablesTemplates)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					string text = list[i];
					if (text.StartsWith(adsVariablesTemplate.AdsKeyName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
					{
						list2.Add(GetFermentationAdsVariable(text, adsVariablesTemplate));
						stack.Push(i);
					}
				}
				while (stack.Count > 0)
				{
					list.RemoveAt(stack.Pop());
				}
			}
			return list2;
		}

		private static ProfileADSFermenVariable GetFermentationAdsVariable(string completeADSName, ProfileADSFermenVariableTemplate template)
		{
			string text = template.DescriptionTemplate;
			if (template.TryAppendComponentName)
			{
				string text2 = completeADSName.Split('_')?.LastOrDefault();
				text = (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text2) ? text : (text + " " + text2));
			}
			return new ProfileADSFermenVariable(completeADSName, text);
		}
	}

		}

		private void RefreshVariableGrid(AdsDataGrid grid, string adsPreKey)
		{
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00ef: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0107: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0120: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0129: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (grid == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(adsPreKey))
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<string> containStringVariableNames = GetContainStringVariableNames(adsPreKey);
			if (containStringVariableNames == null || !containStringVariableNames.Any())
			{
				grid.IndexerPath = string.Empty;
				return;
			}
			grid.IndexerPath = "@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.ArrayProfile";
			grid.Fields.Clear();
			BatchOpAdsField item = new BatchOpAdsField
			{
				Label = BatchProcessResources.MMBatchOP_ProFileResult_MassTransfer_Time,
				UnitsKind = 24,
				DataAttribute = "value",
				PropertyPath = "@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.ArrayProfile.@rowid.CurrentTime",
				IsFrozen = true,
				Width = 100.0
			};
			grid.Fields.Add((AdsField)(object)item);
			Dictionary<string, object> massTransferUnits = GetMassTransferUnits();
			foreach (string item3 in containStringVariableNames)
			{
				string text = item3.Replace(adsPreKey, "");
				if (massTransferUnits.Keys.Contains(text) && massTransferUnits[text] != null)
				{
					text = $"{text} ({massTransferUnits[text]})";
				}
				BatchOpAdsField item2 = new BatchOpAdsField
				{
					Label = text,
					DataAttribute = "value",
					PropertyPath = item3,
					Width = 130.0,
					DisplayUnitsInColumn = false
				};
				grid.Fields.Add((AdsField)(object)item2);
			}
			grid.UpdateDataGrid();
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetContainStringVariableNames(string containString)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			try
			{
				return new ArrayProfileAccessor(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider.GetActiveAdbTop(), (ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this).GetAllVariableNames(0)?.Where((string p) => p.Contains(containString));
			}
			catch
			{
				return new List<string>();
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<string, object> GetMassTransferUnits()
		{
			Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.MassTransferUnitsCustomVar", (IAdbTopProvider)null);
			if (val != null && val.success)
			{
				IEnumerable<AccessorElement> children = AccessorElementExtensions.GetChildren(val);
				if (children != null && children.Any())
				{
					foreach (AccessorElement item in children)
					{
						if (item.success && item.value != null)
						{
							dictionary[item.attribute] = item.value;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private void SetDefaultValue()
		{
			string parentElementPath = "@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.#0.ReactionSetRates";
			IEnumerable<string> elementCollection = GetElementCollection(parentElementPath);
			IOrderedEnumerable<string> orderedEnumerable = elementCollection.OrderBy((string p) => p, SortingComparer);
			if (elementCollection == null || elementCollection.Count() < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (IEnumerator<string> enumerator = orderedEnumerable.GetEnumerator())
			{
				if (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					string current = enumerator.Current;
					ReactionSet_Selected = current;
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ReactionID_Selected))
			{
				return;
			}
			string parentElementPath2 = $"@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.#0.ReactionSetRates.{_reactionSet_Selected}.KineticValues";
			IEnumerable<string> elementCollection2 = GetElementCollection(parentElementPath2);
			if (elementCollection2 == null || elementCollection2.Count() < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			using IEnumerator<string> enumerator = elementCollection2.GetEnumerator();
			if (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				string current2 = enumerator.Current;
				ReactionID_Selected = current2;
			}
		}

				}
			}
		}

		private void SetUnitForFields()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_reactionSet_Selected) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_reactionID_Selected))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<string> obj = new List<string>
			{
				$"@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.#0.ReactionSetRates.{_reactionSet_Selected}.KineticValues.{_reactionID_Selected}.HoldUpUnitType",
				$"@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.#0.ReactionSetRates.{_reactionSet_Selected}.KineticValues.{_reactionID_Selected}.CatMassUnitType",
				$"@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.#0.ReactionSetRates.{_reactionSet_Selected}.KineticValues.{_reactionID_Selected}.ExtentUnitType"
			};
			int num = 0;
			foreach (string item in obj)
			{
				num++;
				AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, item, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (val == null || !val.success || val.value == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int result = 0;
				if (int.TryParse(val.value.ToString(), out result))
				{
					switch (num)
					{
					case 1:
						HoldUpUnitType = result;
						break;
					case 2:
						CatMassUnitType = result;
						break;
					case 3:
						ExtentUnitType = result;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetLableForRplugField()
		{
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main", "type")).Equals("Rplug", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) && _view != null)
			{
				_view.grdReacRates.Fields.FirstOrDefault((AdsField p) => p.Key == "reactionVolumeField").Label = ApwnResources.MMRCSTR_Result_ReactionRates_ReactionVolume_Rplug;
				_view.grdReacRates.Fields.FirstOrDefault((AdsField p) => p.Key == "catalystWeightField").Label = ApwnResources.MMRCSTR_Result_ReactionRates_CatalystWeight_Rplug;
				_view.grdReacRates.Fields.FirstOrDefault((AdsField p) => p.Key == "extentField").Label = ApwnResources.MMRCSTR_Result_ReactionRates_Extent_Rplug;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetElementCollection(string parentElementPath)
		{
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, parentElementPath, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val == null || !val.success)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val);
			if (elementChildren == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (AccessorElement item in elementChildren)
			{
				yield return item.attribute;
			}
		}

		private void NotifyUIMakeChange()
		{
			RefreshReationType();
			SetVisibilityState();
			SetUnitForFields();
			RefreshGrid();
		}

		private void RefreshGrid()
		{
			MMBatchOp_AdsProfil_ReactionRates mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_ReactionRates = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMBatchOp_AdsProfil_ReactionRates;
			if (_reactionSet_Selected != null && _reactionID_Selected != null && mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_ReactionRates != null && mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_ReactionRates.grdReacRates != null)
			{
				mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_ReactionRates.grdReacRates.UpdateDataGrid();
				mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_ReactionRates.grdReacRates.InvalidateGridData();
			}
		}

		private void RefreshReationType()
		{
			string text = $"@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.#0.ReactionSetRates.{_reactionSet_Selected}.ReationType";
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (val.value != null)
				{
					ReactionType = val.value.ToString();
				}
				if (ReactionType.ToUpper() == "FERMENTATION")
				{
					ReactionIDEnabled = Visibility.Collapsed;
					NetRateColumnVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				else
				{
					ReactionIDEnabled = Visibility.Visible;
					NetRateColumnVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
					SetUnitToNetRateFiled();
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private bool HasFiltrationResults
		{
			get
			{
				AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.TotalArea", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (val != null && val.success && CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(val.value).HasValue)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool HasVentResults
		{
			get
			{
				AccessorElement adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.MolFlowCompVent", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				string[] adsArrayData = GetAdsArrayData(adbElement);
				if (adsArrayData == null || adsArrayData.Count() == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private bool HasFeedResults
		{
			get
			{
				AccessorElement adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.DrawStreams", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				string[] adsArrayData = GetAdsArrayData(adbElement);
				if (adsArrayData != null && adsArrayData.Count() > 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.FeedStreams", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				adsArrayData = GetAdsArrayData(adbElement);
				if (adsArrayData != null && adsArrayData.Count() > 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool HasFermentationResults
		{
			get
			{
				AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.FermentationResults", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (!val.success)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (val.value != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private string[] GetAdsArrayData(AccessorElement adbElement)
		{
			if (adbElement == null || !adbElement.success)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, adbElement);
			if (elementChildren == null || elementChildren.Count() == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return elementChildren.Select((AccessorElement p) => AdbExtensions.GetName(p)).ToArray();
		}

		private void SetTabAccessible()
		{
			MMBatchOp_AdsResults v = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMBatchOp_AdsResults;
			if (v != null)
			{
				((DispatcherObject)(object)v).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					v.tabVent.Accessible = HasVentResults;
					v.tabFeed.Accessible = HasFeedResults;
					v.tabFiltration.Accessible = HasFiltrationResults;
					v.MMTabItem_Fermentation.Accessible = HasFermentationResults;
				});
			}
		}
	}

		private bool HaveResults(string path)
		{
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, path, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val);
			if (elementChildren == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (AccessorElement item in elementChildren)
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetTabAccessible()
		{
			MMBatchOp_AdsProfil v = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMBatchOp_AdsProfil;
			if (v != null)
			{
				((DispatcherObject)(object)v).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					v.filtrationTab.Accessible = HasFiltrationResults;
					v.composFilTab.Accessible = HasFiltrationResults;
					v.MMTabItem_CustomReactions.Accessible = HasCustomReactionsResults || HasCustomMassTransferResults;
					v.MMTabItem_ComponentRates.Accessible = HasComponentRatesResults;
					v.MMTabItem_ReactionRates.Accessible = HasReactionRatesResults;
					v.MMTabItem_Fermentation.Accessible = HasFermentationResults;
					v.MMTabItem_Concentration.Accessible = HasConcentrationResults;
					v.MMTabItem_MassTranfer.Accessible = HasMassTransferResults;
				});
			}
		}

		private void MMTabStrip1_SelectedTabItemChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ShowOrHideBatchOpFlowsheet();
		}

		private void ShowOrHideBatchOpFlowsheet(bool isLoaded = false)
		{
			MMTabStrip mMTabStrip = MMTabStrip1;
			if (((mMTabStrip != null) ? mMTabStrip.ActiveTab : null) == null || _isFirstLoaded || !BatchOpUISetup.IsReactorDisplayed || !BatchOpUISetup.IsReactorDisplayEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (((FrameworkElement)(object)MMTabStrip1.ActiveTab).Name == "tab5" || ((FrameworkElement)(object)MMTabStrip1.ActiveTab).Name == "tab6")
			{
				if (isLoaded || GetBatchOpFlowSheetDisplayState())
				{
					HideBatchOpFlowsheet();
				}
			}
			else if (isLoaded || !GetBatchOpFlowSheetDisplayState())
			{
				ShowBatchOpFlowsheet();
			}
		}

		private void MMBatchOp_HeatXfer_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_isFirstLoaded)
			{
				_isFirstLoaded = false;
				SelectValidTabItem();
				InitTabItems();
				MMTabStrip1.SelectedTabItemChanged += MMTabStrip1_SelectedTabItemChanged;
			}
			ShowOrHideBatchOpFlowsheet(isLoaded: true);
		}

		private void InitTabItems()
		{
			((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				foreach (MMTabItem item in MMTabStrip1.Items)
				{
					item.VisibilityChanged += Item_VisibilityChanged;
				}
			});
		}

		private void SelectValidTabItem()
		{
			((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				MMTabItem val = null;
				foreach (MMTabItem item in MMTabStrip1.Items)
				{
					if (((UIElement)(object)item).Visibility == Visibility.Visible && ((TabItem)(object)item).IsSelected)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (((UIElement)(object)item).Visibility == Visibility.Visible && val == null)
					{
						val = item;
					}
				}
				if (val != null)
				{
					((TabItem)(object)val).IsSelected = true;
				}
			});
		}

		private void Item_VisibilityChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<Visibility> e)
		{
			MMTabItem val = (MMTabItem)((sender is MMTabItem) ? sender : null);
			if (val != null && e.NewValue == Visibility.Collapsed && ((TabItem)(object)val).IsSelected)
			{
				SelectValidTabItem();
			}
		}

		protected override void ChangeReactorDisplayStatus(bool isVisible)
		{
			if ((((FrameworkElement)(object)MMTabStrip1.ActiveTab)?.Name == "tab5" || ((FrameworkElement)(object)MMTabStrip1.ActiveTab)?.Name == "tab6") && isVisible)
			{
				if (GetBatchOpFlowSheetDisplayState())
				{
					HideBatchOpFlowsheet();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.ChangeReactorDisplayStatus(isVisible);
			}
		}

	internal class ComponentColumnHeaderConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is string text)
			{
				string[] array = text.Split(' ');
				if (array != null && array.Length == 3 && string.Equals(array[1], array[2], StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return array[0] + " " + array[1];
				}

		{

			{

		private void RefreshGrid()
		{

			if (_SubStreams_Selected != null && mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_Crystal != null && mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_Crystal.grdCrystal != null)
			{
				string text = ((_oldSubStream == null) ? _SubStreams_Selected : _oldSubStream);
				RemoveColumnForGrid(mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_Crystal.grdCrystal, "GROWTH_RATE_" + text, "AGGLOM_RATE_" + text);
				UpdateNucleationRateColumnToGrid(mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_Crystal.grdCrystal);
				UpdateSuperColumnToGrid(mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_Crystal.grdCrystal);
				UpdateGrowthRateColumnToGrid(mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_Crystal.grdCrystal, _SubStreams_Selected);
				UpdateAgglomRateColumnToGrid(mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_Crystal.grdCrystal, _SubStreams_Selected);
				mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_Crystal.grdCrystal.UpdateDataGrid();
				mMBatchOp_AdsProfil_Crystal.grdCrystal.InvalidateGridData();
			}
		}

		private void RemoveColumnForGrid(AdsDataGrid grid, params string[] addString)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string> { "NucleationRate", "RelativeSuperSaturation", "SuperSaturation" };
			list.AddRange(addString);
			List<AdsField> list2 = new List<AdsField>();
			foreach (AdsField field in grid.Fields)
			{
				if (field.Tag != null && list.Contains(field.Tag.ToString()))
				{
					list2.Add(field);
				}
			}
			foreach (AdsField item in list2)
			{
				grid.Fields.Remove(item);
			}
		}

				AccessorElement valueAccessor = ADSProfileHelper.GetValueAccessor(i, $"{_existColumnPath}{component}");
				if (valueAccessor != null && valueAccessor.success && CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(valueAccessor.value) == true)
				{
					rowUnit = ADSProfileHelper.GetPhysicalType(i, $"{VariableAdsPath}{component}");
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void BuildADSPath(string firstSub = null)
		{
			string arg = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("comFilFirstGroupParameter"));
			string arg2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("comFilSecondGroupParameter"));
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("comFilThirdGroupParameter"));
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (text.Equals("Accumulated"))
			{
				isAccumnlated = true;
			}
			else
			{
				isAccumnlated = false;
			}
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("_substream_select_Fil"));
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && firstSub != null)
			{
				text2 = firstSub;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				text2 = lastSubStream;
			}
			else
			{
				lastSubStream = text2;
			}
			if (text2.Equals("$TOTAL"))
			{
				empty = $"{arg} {arg2} {text} Total";
				if (_activeVariableDic.ContainsKey(empty))
				{
					_existColumnPath = _activeVariableDic[empty] + "_";
				}
				if (_adsVariableDic.ContainsKey(empty))
				{
					VariableAdsPath = _adsVariableDic[empty] + "_";
				}
			}
			else
			{
				empty = $"{arg} {arg2} {text}";
				if (_activeVariableDic.ContainsKey(empty))
				{
					_existColumnPath = _activeVariableDic[empty] + "_" + text2 + "_";
				}
				if (_adsVariableDic.ContainsKey(empty))
				{
					VariableAdsPath = _adsVariableDic[empty] + "_" + text2 + "_";
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetVisibilityForAdsGrid()
		{
			MMBatchOp_Profil_ComposFiltration v = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMBatchOp_Profil_ComposFiltration;
			if (v == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			((DispatcherObject)(object)v).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (!HasFiltrationResults)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)v.grdForQE).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					((UIElement)(object)v.grdComFil).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				else
				{
					((UIElement)(object)v.grdForQE).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					((UIElement)(object)v.grdComFil).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
			});
		}

		public override void OnSimulationIntegrationStep()
		{
			string text = "@main.SharedData.PotHoldup";
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			List<AccessorElement> list = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val).ToList();
			if (list.Count() >= 1)
			{
				string firstSub = list[0].attribute.ToString();
				BuildADSPath(firstSub);
				SetVisibilityForAdsGrid();
				base.OnSimulationIntegrationStep();
			}
		}

		public override void OnSimulationRunStarted()
		{
			columnNameList.Clear();
			ADSProfileHelper.ClearDictionary();
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchOp_Profil_ComposFiltration { grdComFil: not null } mMBatchOp_Profil_ComposFiltration)
			{
				mMBatchOp_Profil_ComposFiltration.grdComFil.Fields.Clear();
				mMBatchOp_Profil_ComposFiltration.grdComFil.UpdateWithSimulationIntegrationStep = false;
				mMBatchOp_Profil_ComposFiltration.grdComFil.IndexerPath = string.Empty;
			}
			base.OnSimulationRunStarted();
		}

		public override void OnSimulationRunCompleted()
		{
			RefreshGrid();
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			if (!base.IsSimulating && ((UIElement)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/).IsEnabled)
			{
				RefreshGrid();
			}
			SetVisibilityForAdsGrid();
			lastSubStream = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("_substream_select"));
			base.OnViewChanged();
		}

		public override void OnSimulationRunPaused()
		{
			RefreshGrid();
			base.OnSimulationRunPaused();
		}

		public override void OnSimulationRunFailed()
		{
			RefreshGrid();
			base.OnSimulationRunFailed();
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("FGroup_MultiMap.Value", (object)"FGroup_MultiMap_1");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("SGroup_MultiMap.Value", (object)"SGroup_MultiMap_1");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("TGroup_MultiMap.Value", (object)"TGroup_MultiMap_1");
			}
			SetVisibilityForAdsGrid();
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (subPropertyName == "Value" && !base.IsSimulating)
			{
				BuildADSPath();
				RefreshGrid();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

			if (!(((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchOp_Profil_Composition { grdComposition: not null } mMBatchOp_Profil_Composition))
			{
				return;
			}
			string timeHeader = ApwnResources.MMRBatch_Profil_Compos_MMFLabel1;
			string text = "@main.SharedData.MassCompPotSum";
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val);
			if (elementChildren.Count() < 1 || _existColumnPath == null || _variableAdsPath == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<AdsField> list = new List<AdsField>();
			ADSProfileHelper.RefreshArrayProfileAccessor();
			foreach (AccessorElement item3 in elementChildren)
			{
				string text2 = $"{VariableAdsPath}{item3.attribute}";
				int physicalType = ADSProfileHelper.GetPhysicalType(0, text2);
				if (columnNameList.Contains(item3.attribute))
				{
					continue;
				}
				int rowUnit = 0;
				if (!ExistColumn(item3.attribute, ref rowUnit))
				{
					continue;
				}
				BatchOpAdsField val2 = new BatchOpAdsField
				{

					DataAttribute = "value",

				};

				}

				{
					continue;
				}

				string existColumnPath = _existColumnPath;
				if (_variableAdsPath.StartsWith("MOL_CON_"))
				{
					_variableAdsPath = (_existColumnPath = "MOL_CON_VEQ_");
				}
				else if (_variableAdsPath.StartsWith("MAS_CON_"))
				{
					_variableAdsPath = (_existColumnPath = "MAS_CON_VEQ_");
				}
				text2 = $"{_variableAdsPath}{item3.attribute}";
				physicalType = ADSProfileHelper.GetPhysicalType(0, text2);
				rowUnit = 0;
				if (ExistColumn(item3.attribute, ref rowUnit))
				{
					BatchOpAdsField val3 = new BatchOpAdsField
					{
						Label = "Equilibrium " + item3.attribute,
						DataAttribute = "value",
						PropertyPath = $"{_variableAdsPath}{item3.attribute}",

					};
					if (physicalType != 0)
					{

					}

					{

					}
					if (!columnNameList.Contains(item3.attribute + "_Equilibrium"))
					{
						columnNameList.Add(item3.attribute + "_Equilibrium");
					}
					list.Add((AdsField)(object)val3);
				}
				_variableAdsPath = variableAdsPath;
				_existColumnPath = existColumnPath;
			}
			if (list.Count < 1)
			{
				if (!columnNameList.Contains(timeHeader))
				{
					BatchOpAdsField item = new BatchOpAdsField
					{
						Label = timeHeader,
						DataAttribute = "value",

					};
					mMBatchOp_Profil_Composition.grdComposition.Fields.Add((AdsField)(object)item);

				{
					BatchOpAdsField item2 = new BatchOpAdsField
					{
						Label = timeHeader,
						DataAttribute = "value",

					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(val4.PropertyPath))
					{
						val4.PropertyPath = "@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.ArrayProfile.@rowid.CurrentTime";
					}
				}
				foreach (AdsField item4 in list)
				{
					if (!columnNameList.Contains(item4.Label))
					{
						mMBatchOp_Profil_Composition.grdComposition.Fields.Add(item4);
						columnNameList.Add(item4.Label);
					}
				}
			}
			if (mMBatchOp_Profil_Composition.grdComposition.Fields.Count > 1)
			{
				if (!((UIElement)(object)mMBatchOp_Profil_Composition.grdComposition).IsEnabled)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)mMBatchOp_Profil_Composition.grdComposition).IsEnabled = true;
				}

				}

			mMBatchOp_Profil_Composition.grdComposition.InvalidateGridData();
		}

		private bool ExistColumn(string component, ref int rowUnit)
		{
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.ArrayProfile", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);

			{
				AccessorElement valueAccessor = ADSProfileHelper.GetValueAccessor(num, $"{_existColumnPath}{component}");
				if (valueAccessor != null && valueAccessor.success)
				{
					double? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(valueAccessor.value);
					if (num2.HasValue && num2 != 0.0 && num2 != 1E+35)
					{
						rowUnit = ADSProfileHelper.GetPhysicalType(0, $"{_variableAdsPath}{component}");
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
