		private void BuildADSPath(string firstSub = null)
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("_substream_select"));
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && firstSub != null)
			{
				text = firstSub;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = lastSubStream;
			}
			else
			{
				lastSubStream = text;
			}
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("_phase_select"));
			string empty = string.Empty;
			string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("composFirstGroupParameter"));
			string text4 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("composSecondGroupParameter"));
			string text5 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("composThirdGroupParameter"));
			if (text5.Equals("Accumulated"))
			{
				isAccumulated = true;
			}
			else
			{
				isAccumulated = false;
			}
			_existColumnPath = null;
			VariableAdsPath = null;
			if (text3.Equals("Vessel"))
			{
				if (text.Equals("MIXED"))
				{
					if (!text2.Equals("Total"))
					{
						empty = $"{text3} {text2} {text4} {text5}";
						if (_existColumnDic.ContainsKey(empty))
						{
							_existColumnPath = _existColumnDic[empty] + "_MIXED_";
						}
						if (_adsVariableDic.ContainsKey(empty))
						{
							VariableAdsPath = _adsVariableDic[empty] + "_";
						}
					}
					else
					{
						empty = $"{text3} {text4} {text5}";
						if (_existColumnDic.ContainsKey(empty))
						{
							_existColumnPath = _existColumnDic[empty] + "_MIXED_";
						}
						if (_adsVariableDic.ContainsKey(empty))
						{
							VariableAdsPath = _adsVariableDic[empty] + "_MIXED_";
						}
					}
				}
				else if (text.Equals("$TOTAL"))
				{
					empty = $"{text3} {text4} {text5} Total";
					if (_existColumnDic.ContainsKey(empty))
					{
						_existColumnPath = _existColumnDic[empty] + "_";
					}
					if (_adsVariableDic.ContainsKey(empty))
					{
						VariableAdsPath = _adsVariableDic[empty] + "_";
					}
				}
				else
				{
					empty = $"{text3} {text4} {text5}";
					if (_existColumnDic.ContainsKey(empty))
					{
						_existColumnPath = _existColumnDic[empty] + "_" + text + "_";
					}
					if (_adsVariableDic.ContainsKey(empty))
					{
						VariableAdsPath = _adsVariableDic[empty] + "_" + text + "_";
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				empty = $"{text3} {text4} {text5}";
				if (_existColumnDic.ContainsKey(empty))
				{
					_existColumnPath = _existColumnDic[empty] + "_";
				}
				if (_adsVariableDic.ContainsKey(empty))
				{
					VariableAdsPath = _adsVariableDic[empty] + "_";
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnResolveUpdateParameter(string parameterName, string adsPath)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter(parameterName, (object)adsPath);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<AdsVariablePropertyChangedEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<AdsVariablePropertyChangedEvent>()).Publish(new AdsVariablePropertyChangedEventArgs());
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				UnitsProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IAdbUnitsProvider>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("FirstOptionGroup_MultiMap.Value", (object)"FirstOptionGroup_MultiMap_1");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("SecondOptionGroup_MultiMap.Value", (object)"SecondOptionGroup_MultiMap_1");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("ThirdOptionGroup_MultiMap.Value", (object)"ThirdOptionGroup_MultiMap_1");
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		public override void OnSimulationIntegrationStep()
		{
			string text = "@main.SharedData.PotHoldup";
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			List<AccessorElement> list = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val).ToList();
			if (list.Count >= 1)
			{
				AccessorElement obj = list[0];
				string firstSub = ((obj == null) ? null : obj.attribute?.ToString());
				BuildADSPath(firstSub);
				base.OnSimulationIntegrationStep();
			}
		}

		public override void OnSimulationRunStarted()
		{
			columnNameList.Clear();
			ADSProfileHelper.ClearDictionary();
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchOp_Profil_Composition { grdComposition: not null } mMBatchOp_Profil_Composition)
			{
				mMBatchOp_Profil_Composition.grdComposition.Fields.Clear();
				mMBatchOp_Profil_Composition.grdComposition.UpdateWithSimulationIntegrationStep = false;
				mMBatchOp_Profil_Composition.grdComposition.IndexerPath = string.Empty;
			}
			base.OnSimulationRunStarted();
		}

		public override void OnSimulationRunCompleted()
		{
			RefreshGrid();
			base.OnSimulationRunCompleted();
		}

		public override void OnSimulationRunPaused()
		{
			RefreshGrid();
			base.OnSimulationRunPaused();
		}

		public override void OnSimulationRunFailed()
		{
			RefreshGrid();
			base.OnSimulationRunFailed();
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			if (!base.IsSimulating)
			{
				RefreshGrid();
			}
			lastSubStream = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("_substream_select"));
			base.OnViewChanged();
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (subPropertyName == "Value" && !base.IsSimulating)
			{
				if (pd.Name == "AdCbo_SubStreamSelect" && CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "AdCbo_SubStreamSelect.Value")) != "MIXED" && CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "ThirdOptionGroup_MultiMap.Value")) == "ThirdOptionGroup_MultiMap_3")
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("ThirdOptionGroup_MultiMap.Value", (object)"ThirdOptionGroup_MultiMap_1");
				}
				BuildADSPath();
				RefreshGrid();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.SharedData.DrawStreams", "child_ids"));
			if (array != null)
			{
				string text = array.FirstOrDefault();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("DramStream", (object)$"MA_CUMU_DRAW_{text}", true);
				}
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (pd.Name == "_AdvCboView_sel_view" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				object advCboView_AdvCollection = AdvCboView_AdvCollection;
				CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((advCboView_AdvCollection is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? advCboView_AdvCollection : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					if (val.SelectedItem == "Vessel" || val.SelectedItem == Resources.MMBatchOp_Profil_Proper_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Reactor)
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamReactorVisible", (object)"1");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamVentVisible", (object)"0");

						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamReactorVisible", (object)"0");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamVentVisible", (object)"1");
					}
				}
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		private void SetupL1L2Visibility()
		{
			if (!(((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchOp_AdsResults_HoldupComposition mMBatchOp_AdsResults_HoldupComposition))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AdsDataGrid item in new List<AdsDataGrid> { mMBatchOp_AdsResults_HoldupComposition.grdHoldupMole, mMBatchOp_AdsResults_HoldupComposition.grdHoldupMass, mMBatchOp_AdsResults_HoldupComposition.grdCompositionMole, mMBatchOp_AdsResults_HoldupComposition.grdCompositionMass })
			{
				foreach (AdsField field in item.Fields)
				{
					if (field.Key == "liquid1" || field.Key == "liquid2")
					{
						? val = field;
						object mixedSubstreamAndHasL1L = MixedSubstreamAndHasL1L2;
						((AdsField)val).Visibility = ((CxvLogicalPropertyData)((mixedSubstreamAndHasL1L is CxvLogicalPropertyData) ? mixedSubstreamAndHasL1L : null)).ValueAsVisibility;
					}
					else if (field.Key == "vapor" || field.Key == "liquid" || field.Key == "solid")
					{
						? val2 = field;
						object isMixedSubstream = IsMixedSubstream;
						((AdsField)val2).Visibility = ((CxvLogicalPropertyData)((isMixedSubstream is CxvLogicalPropertyData) ? isMixedSubstream : null)).ValueAsVisibility;
					}
				}
			}
		}

			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.BatchGet(text, "value", (string)null));

		private void UpdateActivity()
		{
			string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.ACT_VALUE");
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text, "child_ids"));
			if (array == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			string[] array2 = array;
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array2[i].Contains("#"))
				{
					((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChild(text, num);
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				}
				num++;
			}
		}

		private void _heatXferGeometry_Dragging(DependencyObject sender, DraggingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			string caseFullFilePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath;
			System.Windows.IDataObject dataObject = e.DataObject;
			MemoryStream asiFileXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFileXml(caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiFileXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI File Format").Name, asiFileXml);
			}
			string asiSelectionXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiSelectionXml((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string> { GetCxsItemMoniker(e.GeometryVariable.DataPath) }, caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiSelectionXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI Format").Name, asiSelectionXml);
			}
			double? value = e.GeometryVariable.Value;
			dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.Text, value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString() : string.Empty);
			DragDrop.DoDragDrop(sender, dataObject, System.Windows.DragDropEffects.Copy);
		}

		private string GetCxsItemMoniker(string dataPath)
		{
			return "cxs:" + ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(dataPath).Replace("appModelV8", "appModel");
		}

		}

		private void _heatXferGeometry_InputChanged(object sender, InputChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet((sender as InputVariable).DataPath, e.Attribute);
			if (e.Value != null && obj != null && obj.ToString() != e.Value.ToString())
			{
				bool flag = true;
				if (!((!e.Attribute.Equals("uom", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ? ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet((sender as InputVariable).DataPath, e.Attribute, e.Value) : ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet((sender as InputVariable).DataPath, "value", e.Value.ToString(), (object)(sender as GeometryVariable).Value)))
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
					Update();
				}
			}
			else if (e.Value == null)
			{
				InputVariable inputVariable = sender as InputVariable;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(inputVariable.DataPath, "value", (string)null, (object)null);
				inputVariable.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				Update();
			}
		}

	public class MMBatchOp_AdsResults_Coils_ViewModel : MMViewModel
	{
		public static readonly CxvPropertyDeclaration grdCoilsHeating_Visibility_Property;

		public static readonly CxvPropertyDeclaration grdCoilsCooling_Visibility_Property;

		public static readonly CxvPropertyDeclaration CHMDTMP_Property;

		public static readonly CxvPropertyDeclaration CCMDTMP_Property;

		public static readonly CxvPropertyDeclaration CHOPT_Property;

		public static readonly CxvPropertyDeclaration CCOPT_Property;

		public static readonly CxvPropertyDeclaration Steam_Property;

		public static readonly CxvPropertyDeclaration SteamLatentHeat_Property;

		public static readonly CxvPropertyDeclaration SteamMaximumDuty_Property;

		public static readonly CxvPropertyDeclaration LMTDHeating_Property;

		public static readonly CxvPropertyDeclaration LMTDCooling_Property;

		public static readonly CxvPropertyDeclaration HeatXferHeating_Property;

		public static readonly CxvPropertyDeclaration HeatXferCooling_Property;

		public object HeatCoolMode
		{
			get
			{
				bool? flag = CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.COIHETMODE", "value"));
				if (CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.COICOLMODE", "value")) == true)
				{
					if (flag == true)
					{
						AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.CoilsMode", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
						if (val != null && val.value != null)
						{
							return CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(val.value);
						}
					}
					return 0.0;
				}
				if (flag == true)
				{
					return 1.0;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public object grdCoilsHeating_Visibility => ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(grdCoilsHeating_Visibility_Property);

		public object grdCoilsCooling_Visibility => ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(grdCoilsCooling_Visibility_Property);

		public object CHMDTMP => ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(CHMDTMP_Property);

		public object CCMDTMP => ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(CCMDTMP_Property);

		public object CHOPT => ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(CHOPT_Property);

		public object CCOPT => ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(CCOPT_Property);

		public object Steam => ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(Steam_Property);

		public object SteamLatentHeat => ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(SteamLatentHeat_Property);

		public object SteamMaximumDuty => ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(SteamMaximumDuty_Property);

		public object LMTDHeating => ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(LMTDHeating_Property);

		public object LMTDCooling => ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(LMTDCooling_Property);

		public object HeatXferHeating => ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(HeatXferHeating_Property);

		public object HeatXferCooling => ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(HeatXferCooling_Property);

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("HeatCoolMode");
		}

		protected override void OnUnityContainerChanged()
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnUnityContainerChanged();

		private void _potGeometry_Dragging(DependencyObject sender, DraggingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			string caseFullFilePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath;
			System.Windows.IDataObject dataObject = e.DataObject;
			MemoryStream asiFileXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFileXml(caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiFileXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI File Format").Name, asiFileXml);
			}
			string asiSelectionXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiSelectionXml((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string> { GetCxsItemMoniker(e.GeometryVariable.DataPath) }, caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiSelectionXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI Format").Name, asiSelectionXml);
			}
			double? value = e.GeometryVariable.Value;
			dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.Text, value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString() : string.Empty);
			DragDrop.DoDragDrop(sender, dataObject, System.Windows.DragDropEffects.Copy);
		}

		private string GetCxsItemMoniker(string dataPath)
		{
			return "cxs:" + ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(dataPath).Replace("appModelV8", "appModel");
		}

		private void _potGeometry_PasteRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (double.TryParse(ClipboardWrapper.GetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.Text).ToString(), out var result))
			{
				(sender as GeometryVariable).Value = result;
			}
		}

		private void _potGeometry_CopyRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)

		}

		private void _potGeometry_CutRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)

		}

		private void _potGeometry_InputChanged(object sender, InputChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!_hasInitilized)
			{
				return;
			}
			InputVariable inputVariable = sender as InputVariable;
			object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute);
			if (e.Value == null)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute, e.Value);
				inputVariable.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				if (sender is GeometryVariable)
				{
					(sender as GeometryVariable).Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute));
				}
			}
			else if (obj != null && obj.ToString() != e.Value.ToString())
			{
				if (!((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute, e.Value))
				{
					(sender as GeometryVariable).Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(obj);
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.CC Nodes.RSPEC"));
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateGeometry(bool geometryCalculation)
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
			PotGeometry.Diameter.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Diameter.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Diameter.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "user_entered")?.ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.TanTanLength.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.TanTanLength.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.TanTanLength.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "user_entered")?.ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.Volume.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Volume.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Volume.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "user_entered")?.ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.ConeHeight.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.ConeHeight.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.ConeHeight.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "user_entered")?.ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.DataPath, "user_entered")?.ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.DataPath, "user_entered")?.ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.TopHead.Value = (HeadType)Enum.Parse(typeof(HeadType), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TopHead.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString());
			PotGeometry.BottomHead.Value = (HeadType)Enum.Parse(typeof(HeadType), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.BottomHead.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString());
			PotGeometry.IsVertical = bool.Parse(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.POTORIENT", "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch)?.ToString().Replace("HORIZONTAL", "False").Replace("VERTICAL", "True"));
			PotGeometry.GeoSpec = (GeoSpec)Enum.Parse(typeof(GeoSpec), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.GEOMETRYSPEC", "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch)?.ToString().Replace("ogrGeoSpec_MultiMapOption_1", "DL").Replace("ogrGeoSpec_MultiMapOption_2", "DV")
				.Replace("ogrGeoSpec_MultiMapOption_3", "LV"));
			UpdateHeatXGeometry();
			if (!PotGeometry.Diameter.Value.HasValue)
			{
				PotGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				if (PotGeometry.GeoSpec == GeoSpec.LV)
				{
					geometryCalculation = true;
				}
			}
			if (!PotGeometry.TanTanLength.Value.HasValue)
			{
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				if (PotGeometry.GeoSpec == GeoSpec.DV)
				{
					geometryCalculation = true;
				}
			}
			if (!PotGeometry.Volume.Value.HasValue)
			{
				PotGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				if (PotGeometry.GeoSpec == GeoSpec.DL)
				{
					geometryCalculation = true;
				}
			}
			switch (PotGeometry.GeoSpec)
			{
			case GeoSpec.DL:
				PotGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = false;
				PotGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				break;
			case GeoSpec.DV:
				PotGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = false;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				PotGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = true;
				break;
			case GeoSpec.LV:
				PotGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = false;
				PotGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = true;
				break;
			}
			PotGeometry.LoadCompleted = true;
			_hasInitilized = true;
			if (geometryCalculation && (lastSpec == PotGeometry.GeoSpec.ToString() || lastSpec == null))
			{
				PotGeometry.CalculateGeometry();
			}
			lastSpec = PotGeometry.GeoSpec.ToString();
		}

	public class MMBatchOp_Setup_PotGeometry : MMTabPage, IComponentConnector

		private MMBatchOp_Setup_PotGeometry_ViewModel _viewModel;

		private int loopNumber;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public MMBatchOp_Setup_PotGeometry()
		{
			((MMViewModelContainer)this).ViewModelType = typeof(MMBatchOp_Setup_PotGeometry_ViewModel);
			((FrameworkElement)this).Loaded += MMBatchOp_Setup_PotGeometry_Loaded;
			InitializeComponent();
			InitTime();
			InitEvent();
		}

		private void MMBatchOp_Setup_PotGeometry_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_viewModel == null)
			{
				_viewModel = ((MMViewModelContainer)this).ViewModel as MMBatchOp_Setup_PotGeometry_ViewModel;
			}
		}

		private void InitEvent()
		{
			((ToggleButton)(object)PotOrientation_opt1).Checked += PotOrientation_opt1_Checked;
			((ToggleButton)(object)PotOrientation_opt2).Checked += PotOrientation_opt2_Checked;
		}

		private void InitTime()
		{
			_checkPotDataUpdateTimer = new System.Timers.Timer();
			_checkPotDataUpdateTimer.Interval = 500.0;
			_checkPotDataUpdateTimer.Elapsed += CheckPotDataUpdateTimer_Elapsed;
		}

		private void CheckPotDataUpdateTimer_Elapsed(object sender, ElapsedEventArgs e)
		{
			((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (_lastCheckPotDataUpdateNumber == _viewModel.CheckPotDataUpdateNumber && !potCtrl.IsEnabled)
				{
					if (loopNumber >= 2)
					{
						potCtrl.IsEnabled = true;
						_lastCheckPotDataUpdateNumber = -1L;
						loopNumber = 0;
						_checkPotDataUpdateTimer.Stop();
						return;
					}
					loopNumber++;
				}
				_lastCheckPotDataUpdateNumber = _viewModel.CheckPotDataUpdateNumber;
			}, DispatcherPriority.Background);
		}

		private void PotOrientation_opt2_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			StartCheckTimer();
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void PotOrientation_opt1_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			StartCheckTimer();
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void StartCheckTimer()
		{
			if (_viewModel != null && potCtrl.IsEnabled)
			{
				potCtrl.IsEnabled = false;
				_lastCheckPotDataUpdateNumber = -1L;
				_viewModel.CheckPotDataUpdateNumber = 0L;
				if (!_checkPotDataUpdateTimer.Enabled)
				{
					_checkPotDataUpdateTimer.Start();
				}
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		public void InitializeComponent()
		{
			if (!_contentLoaded)

		{

			public string UOM { get; set; }
		}

		public LoadVesselDialog(MMBatchOp_Setup_PotGeometry_ViewModel model)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			LoadAspenBatchModelerVesselLibrary();
			ManufacturerList.ItemsSource = ManufacturerListSource;
			_model = model;
		}

		public void LoadAspenBatchModelerVesselLibrary()
		{
			string filename = Registry.GetValue("HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\\SOFTWARE\\AspenTech\\AMSystem\\41.0\\Dir", "Bin", "").ToString() + "VesselLibrary.vsll";
			LoadXML(filename, ref ModelerVesselProperties);
		}

		public void LoadXML(string filename, ref Dictionary<string, VesselDetails> propertiesMap)
		{
			ManufacturerListSource = new List<string>();
			propertiesMap = new Dictionary<string, VesselDetails>();
			string text = string.Empty;
			try
			{
				using XmlReader xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(filename);
				while (xmlReader.Read())
				{
					if (xmlReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element || !(xmlReader.Name == "Vessel"))
					{
						continue;
					}
					VesselDetails vesselDetails = new VesselDetails();
					vesselDetails.PropertyTable = new List<Property>();
					vesselDetails.ID = xmlReader.GetAttribute("VesselID");
					VesselDetails value = new VesselDetails();
					if (propertiesMap.TryGetValue(vesselDetails.ID, out value))
					{
						System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(WpfMMDialogResources.LoadVesselDialog_Message1);
						propertiesMap.Clear();
						return;
					}
					XmlReader xmlReader2 = xmlReader.ReadSubtree();
					while (xmlReader2.Read())
					{
						if (xmlReader2.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element && xmlReader2.Name == "Description")
						{
							string description = xmlReader2.ReadElementContentAsString();
							text = vesselDetails.ID;
							vesselDetails.Description = description;
						}
						if (xmlReader2.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element && xmlReader2.Name == "Manufacturer")
						{
							vesselDetails.Manufacturer = xmlReader2.ReadElementContentAsString();
							if (!ManufacturerListSource.Contains(vesselDetails.Manufacturer))
							{
								ManufacturerListSource.Add(vesselDetails.Manufacturer);
							}
						}
						if (xmlReader2.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element && xmlReader2.Name == "Model")
						{
							vesselDetails.Model = xmlReader2.ReadElementContentAsString();
						}
						if (xmlReader2.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element || !(xmlReader2.Name == "PropertyTable"))
						{
							continue;
						}
						XmlReader xmlReader3 = xmlReader2.ReadSubtree();
						while (xmlReader3.ReadToFollowing("Property"))
						{
							Property property = new Property();
							XmlReader xmlReader4 = xmlReader3.ReadSubtree();
							while (xmlReader4.Read())
							{
								switch (xmlReader4.Name)
								{
								case "Description":
									property.Description = xmlReader3.ReadElementContentAsString();
									property.LocalizedDescription = LocalizeDescription(property.Description);
									break;
								case "Value":
									property.Value = xmlReader3.ReadElementContentAsString();
									break;
								case "UOM":
									property.UOM = xmlReader3.ReadElementContentAsString();
									break;
								}
							}
							if (property.Description == "Jacket covers bottom" || property.Description == "Jacket covers bottom head")
							{
								if (property.Value == "1")
								{
									property.Value = "Yes";
								}
								else if (property.Value == "0")
								{
									property.Value = "No";
								}
							}
							vesselDetails.PropertyTable.Add(property);
						}
					}
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						text = vesselDetails.ID;
					}
					propertiesMap.Add(text, vesselDetails);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(WpfMMDialogResources.LoadVesselDialog_Message2);
			}
			ManufacturerListSource.Sort();
		}

		private string LocalizeDescription(string Description)
		{
			string result = Description;
			switch (Description.ToUpper())
			{
			case "CAPACITY":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_Capacity;
				break;
			case "FOULING COEFFICIENT":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_FoulingCoefficient;
				break;
			case "LINING CONDUCTIVITY":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_LiningConductivity;
				break;
			case "LINING THICKNESS":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_LiningThickness;
				break;
			case "MINIMUM STIRRED VOLUME":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_MinimumStirredVolume;
				break;
			case "STRAIGHT SIDE":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_StraightSide;
				break;
			case "SURFACE AREA":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_SurfaceArea;
				break;
			case "INTERNAL DIAMETER":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_InternalDiameter;
				break;
			case "VESSEL MASS":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_VesselMass;
				break;
			case "WALL CONDUCTIVITY":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_WallConductivity;
				break;
			case "WALL THICKNESS":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_WallThickness;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void ComboBox_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ManufacturerList.SelectedItem != null)
			{
				List<string> list = (from pair in ModelerVesselProperties
					where pair.Value.Manufacturer == ManufacturerList.SelectedItem.ToString()
					select pair.Value.Description).ToList();
				list.Sort();
				VesselList.ItemsSource = list;
			}
			else
			{
				VesselList.ItemsSource = null;
			}
		}

		private void VesselList_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (VesselList.SelectedItem != null)
			{
				List<VesselDetails> list = (from pair in ModelerVesselProperties
					where pair.Value.Description == VesselList.SelectedItem.ToString()
					select pair.Value).ToList();
				if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
				{
					currentSelection = list[0];
					VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = currentSelection.PropertyTable;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = null;
			}
		}

		private void OKbutton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (rbModelerLibrary.IsChecked == true && ManufacturerList.SelectedItem == null)
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(WpfMMDialogResources.LoadVesselDialog_Message3);
				return;
			}
			if (rbModelerLibrary.IsChecked == true && VesselList.SelectedItem == null)
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(WpfMMDialogResources.LoadVesselDialog_Message4);
				return;
			}
			if (rbUserLibrary.IsChecked == true && string.IsNullOrEmpty(VesselLibraryText.Text))
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(WpfMMDialogResources.LoadVesselDialog_Message5);
				return;
			}
			if (rbUserLibrary.IsChecked == true && VesselID.SelectedItem == null)
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(WpfMMDialogResources.LoadVesselDialog_Message6);
				return;
			}
			if (rbUserLibrary.IsChecked == true && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(VesselLibraryText.Text))
			{
				((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VESSELLIB", "value", (object)VesselLibraryText.Text);
			}
			((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VESSELID", "value", (object)currentSelection.ID);
			((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VDESCRIPTION", "value", (object)currentSelection.Description);
			foreach (Property item in currentSelection.PropertyTable)
			{
				double result = 0.0;
				string empty = string.Empty;
				switch (item.Description.ToUpper())
				{
				case "VESSEL MASS":
				case "MASS":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POT_MASS", "value", item.UOM, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "GEOMETRY SPECIFICATION":
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.GEOMETRYSPEC", "value", (object)item.Value.ToUpper());
					break;
				case "TOP HEAD TYPE":
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POTTOPHEAD", "value", (object)item.Value.ToUpper());
					break;
				case "ORIENTATION":
				case "POT ORIENTATION":
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POTORIENT", "value", (object)item.Value.ToUpper());
					break;
				case "BOTTOM HEAD TYPE":
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POTBTMHEAD", "value", (object)item.Value.ToUpper());
					break;
				case "WALL CONDUCTIVITY":
				case "WALL THERMAL CONDUCTIVITY":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetWallConductivityUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POTWALLK", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "DISH RADIUS RATIO":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POTRATDISH", "value", item.UOM, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "CONE HEIGHT":
				case "HEIGHT OF CONICAL HEAD":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POTCONEHT", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "KNUCKLE RADIUS RATIO":
				case "RATIO OF   KNUCKLE RADIUS TO VESSEL DIAMETER":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POTRATKNCK", "value", item.UOM, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "WALL THICKNESS":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POTWALLTH", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "INTERNAL DIAMETER":
				case "DIAMETER":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POTDIAM", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "CAPACITY":
				case "VOLUME":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetCapacityUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POTVOL", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "STRAIGHT SIDE":
				case "TANGENT-TO-TANGENT LENGTH":
				case "TAN-TAN LENGTH":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POTLENGTAN", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "JACKET COVERS BOTTOM HEAD":
				case "JACKET COVERS BOTTOM":
				{
					int checkboxSetting = GetCheckboxSetting(item.Value);
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.JKCOVERHD", "value", (object)checkboxSetting);
					break;
				}
				case "JACKET BOTTOM HEIGHT":
				case "HEIGHT OF JACKET BOTTOM FROM VESSEL BOTTOM":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.JKBTMHG", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "JACKET TOP HEIGHT":
				case "HEIGHT OF JACKET TOP FROM VESSEL BOTTOM":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.JKTOPHG", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "COILS HEAT TRANSFER AREA":
				case "COIL HEAT TRANSFER AREA":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetAreaUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.COIHEATAREA", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "COIL TOP HEIGHT":
				case "HEIGHT OF COIL TOP FROM VESSEL BOTTOM":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.COITOPHG", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "COIL BOTTOM HEIGHT":
				case "HEIGHT OF COIL BOTTOM FROM VESSEL BOTTOM":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.COIBTMHG", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "EXCHANGER HEAT TRANSFER AREA":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetAreaUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.AEXTHX", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "RECIRCULATION RATE":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.FMEXTHX", "value", item.UOM, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "AGITATOR":
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.AGIT_TYPE", "value", (object)item.Value.ToUpper());
					break;
				case "AGITATOR DIAMETER":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.IMPELLER_DIA", "value", item.UOM, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			Close();
		}

		private string SetLengthUnits(string uom)
		{
			string result = uom;
			if (uom == "m")
			{
				result = "meter";
			}
			return result;
		}

		private int GetCheckboxSetting(string value)
		{
			int result = 1;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				if (value.ToUpper() == "TRUE" || value.ToUpper() == "YES")
				{
					result = 1;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(value.ToUpper() == "FALSE") && !(value.ToUpper() == "NO"))
					{
						int.TryParse(value, out result);
						return result;
					}
					result = 0;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string SetWallConductivityUnits(string value)
		{
			string result = value;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				switch (value.ToUpper())
				{
				case "BTU IN/H/FT2/R":
					result = "Btu-in/hr-sqft-R";
					break;
				case "BTU/H/FT/F":
					result = "Btu/hr-ft-F";
					break;
				case "CAL CM/S/CM2/K":
					result = "cal-cm/sec-sqcm-K";
					break;
				case "KCAL/H/M/K":
					result = "kcal/hr-m-K";
					break;
				case "KW/M/K":
					result = "kW/m-K";
					break;
				case "W/M/K":
					result = "Watt/m-K";
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string SetCapacityUnits(string value)
		{
			string result = value;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				switch (value.ToUpper())
				{
				case "FT3":
					result = "cuft";
					break;
				case "IN3":
					result = "cuin";
					break;
				case "M3":
					result = "cum";
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string SetAreaUnits(string value)
		{
			string result = value;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				switch (value.ToUpper())
				{
				case "CM2":
					result = "sqcm";
					break;
				case "FT2":
					result = "sqft";
					break;
				case "IN2":
					result = "sqin";
					break;
				case "M2":
					result = "sqm";
					break;
				case "MILE2":
					result = "sqmile";
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void rbModelerLibrary_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ModelerOptions != null)
			{
				ModelerOptions.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			if (UserOptions != null)
			{
				UserOptions.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			if (VesselDescriptionText != null)
			{
				VesselDescriptionText.Text = null;
			}
			if (VesselPropTable != null)
			{
				VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = null;
			}
		}

		private void rbUserLibrary_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ModelerOptions != null)
			{
				ModelerOptions.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			if (UserOptions != null)
			{
				UserOptions.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			if (ManufacturerList != null)
			{
				ManufacturerList.SelectedItem = null;
			}
			if (VesselList != null)
			{
				VesselList.SelectedItem = null;
			}
			if (VesselPropTable != null)
			{
				VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = null;
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VESSELLIB", "value"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && File.Exists(text))
			{
				VesselLibraryText.Text = text;
				if (File.Exists(VesselLibraryText.Text))
				{
					LoadXML(VesselLibraryText.Text, ref UserVesselProperties);
					List<string> list = UserVesselProperties.Values.Select((VesselDetails c) => c.ID).ToList();
					list.Sort();
					VesselID.ItemsSource = list;
					VesselDescriptionText.Text = null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VesselLibraryText.Text = null;
				if (VesselID != null)
				{
					VesselID.ItemsSource = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void BrowseBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Forms.OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new System.Windows.Forms.OpenFileDialog();
			openFileDialog.Filter = "Vessel Library Files (*.vsll)|*.vsll";
			openFileDialog.Title = "Open vessel library";
			openFileDialog.CheckPathExists = true;
			openFileDialog.RestoreDirectory = true;
			if (openFileDialog.ShowDialog() == System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult.OK)
			{
				VesselLibraryText.Text = openFileDialog.FileName;
				LoadXML(openFileDialog.FileName, ref UserVesselProperties);
				List<string> list = UserVesselProperties.Values.Select((VesselDetails c) => c.ID).ToList();
				list.Sort();
				VesselID.ItemsSource = list;
				VesselDescriptionText.Text = null;
			}
		}

		private void VesselID_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (VesselID.SelectedItem != null)
			{
				VesselDetails value = new VesselDetails();
				if (UserVesselProperties.TryGetValue(VesselID.SelectedItem.ToString(), out value))
				{
					currentSelection = value;
					VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = currentSelection.PropertyTable;
					VesselDescriptionText.Text = currentSelection.Description;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = null;
			}
		}

		public SaveVesselDialog(MMBatchOp_Setup_PotGeometry_ViewModel model)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			_model = model;
			_vesselLibrary = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VESSELLIB", "value"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_vesselLibrary) && File.Exists(_vesselLibrary))
			{
				VesselLibraryText.Text = _vesselLibrary;
			}
			else
			{
				VesselLibraryText.Text = Directory.GetCurrentDirectory() + "\\UserVesselLibrary.vsll";
			}
			_vesselID = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VESSELID", "value"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_vesselID))
			{
				VesselIDText.Text = _vesselID;
			}
			_vesselDescription = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VDESCRIPTION", "value"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_vesselDescription))
			{
				VesselDescriptionText.Text = _vesselDescription;
			}
			vesselDetails = new List<Property>();
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_MassItem, "@main.Input.POT_MASS", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_WallThickness, "@main.Input.POTWALLTH", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_WallThermalConductivity, "@main.Input.POTWALLK", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_GeometrySpecification, "@main.Input.GEOMETRYSPEC", ref vesselDetails);
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.GEOMETRYSPEC", "value"));
			if (text != "LV")
			{
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_Diameter, "@main.Input.POTDIAM", ref vesselDetails);
			}
			if (text != "DL")
			{
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_VolumeItem, "@main.Input.POTVOL", ref vesselDetails);
			}
			if (text != "DV")
			{
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_TanTanLength, "@main.Input.POTLENGTAN", ref vesselDetails);
			}
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_PotOrientation, "@main.Input.POTORIENT", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_TopHeadType, "@main.Input.POTTOPHEAD", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_BottomHeadType, "@main.Input.POTBTMHEAD", ref vesselDetails);
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.POTTOPHEAD", "value"));
			string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.POTBTMHEAD", "value"));
			if ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && text2 == "TORISPHERICAL") || (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3) && text3 == "TORISPHERICAL"))
			{
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_DishRadiusRatio, "@main.Input.POTRATDISH", ref vesselDetails);
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_KnuckleRadiusRatio, "@main.Input.POTRATKNCK", ref vesselDetails);
			}
			if ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && text2 == "CONICAL") || (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3) && text3 == "CONICAL"))
			{
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_ConeHeight, "@main.Input.POTCONEHT", ref vesselDetails);
			}
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_JacketCoversBottom, "@main.Input.JKCOVERHD", ref vesselDetails, ConvertCheckbox: true);
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.JKCOVERHD", "value"));
			if (num.HasValue && num == 0)
			{
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_JacketBottomHeight, "@main.Input.JKBTMHG", ref vesselDetails);
			}
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_JacketTopHeight, "@main.Input.JKTOPHG", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_CoilsHeatTransferArea, "@main.Input.COIHEATAREA", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_CoilTopHeight, "@main.Input.COITOPHG", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_CoilBottomHeight, "@main.Input.COIBTMHG", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_ExchangerHeat, "@main.Input.AEXTHX", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_RecirculationRate, "@main.Input.FMEXTHX", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_Agitator, "@main.Input.AGIT_TYPE", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_AgitatorDiameter, "@main.Input.IMPELLER_DIA", ref vesselDetails);
			VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = vesselDetails;
		}

		private void AddToDetails(string Description, string DataPath, ref List<Property> details, bool ConvertCheckbox = false)
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(DataPath, "value"));
			string uOM = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(DataPath, "uom"));
			bool? flag = CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(DataPath, "user_entered"));
			Property property = new Property();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && flag.HasValue && flag == true)
			{
				property.Description = Description;
				if (!ConvertCheckbox)
				{
					property.Value = text;
				}
				else if (text == "0")
				{
					property.Value = "No";
				}
				else if (text == "1")
				{
					property.Value = "Yes";
				}
				property.UOM = uOM;
				details.Add(property);
			}
		}

		private void OKbutton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(VesselIDText.Text))
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show("Vessel ID must be specified.");
				return;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(VesselLibraryText.Text))
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show("Vessel library must be specified.");
				return;
			}
			if (System.IO.Path.GetExtension(VesselLibraryText.Text).ToLower() != ".vsll")
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show("Please enter a valid library name.  A valid library name has the extension \".vsll\".");
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (VesselIDText.Text != _vesselID)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VESSELID", "value", (object)VesselIDText.Text);
				}
				if (VesselDescriptionText.Text != _vesselDescription)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VDESCRIPTION", "value", (object)VesselDescriptionText.Text);
				}
				if (VesselLibraryText.Text != _vesselLibrary)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VESSELLIB", "value", (object)VesselLibraryText.Text);
				}
				if (!File.Exists(VesselLibraryText.Text))
				{
					XmlWriterSettings xmlWriterSettings = new XmlWriterSettings();
					xmlWriterSettings.Indent = true;
					using XmlWriter xmlWriter = XmlWriter.Create(VesselLibraryText.Text, xmlWriterSettings);
					xmlWriter.WriteStartDocument();
					xmlWriter.WriteStartElement("VesselTable");
					xmlWriter.WriteStartElement("Vessel");
					xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString("VesselID", VesselIDText.Text);
					xmlWriter.WriteElementString("Description", VesselDescriptionText.Text);
					xmlWriter.WriteStartElement("PropertyTable");
					foreach (Property vesselDetail in vesselDetails)
					{
						xmlWriter.WriteStartElement("Property");
						xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString("Name", vesselDetail.Description.Replace(" ", ""));
						xmlWriter.WriteElementString("Description", vesselDetail.Description);
						xmlWriter.WriteElementString("Value", vesselDetail.Value);
						xmlWriter.WriteElementString("UOM", vesselDetail.UOM);
						xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
					}
					xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
					xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
					xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
					xmlWriter.WriteEndDocument();
					xmlWriter.Close();
				}
				else
				{
					XDocument xDocument = XDocument.Load(VesselLibraryText.Text);
					XElement xElement = xDocument.Element("VesselTable");
					XElement xElement2 = (from vessel in xElement.Elements("Vessel")
						where vessel.Attribute("VesselID").Value == VesselIDText.Text
						select vessel).FirstOrDefault();
					if (xElement2 != null)
					{
						if (System.Windows.MessageBox.Show("Replace existing vessel with ID \"" + VesselIDText.Text + "\"?", "Replace Confirmation", MessageBoxButton.YesNo) != MessageBoxResult.Yes)
						{
							return;
						}
						xElement2.Remove();
					}
					xElement.Add(new XElement("Vessel", new XAttribute("VesselID", VesselIDText.Text), new XElement("Description", VesselDescriptionText.Text), new XElement("PropertyTable")));
					if (vesselDetails != null && vesselDetails.Count > 0)
					{
						XElement xElement3 = (from vessel in xElement.Elements("Vessel")
							where vessel.Attribute("VesselID").Value == VesselIDText.Text
							select vessel).FirstOrDefault();
						if (xElement3 != null)
						{
							XElement xElement4 = xElement3.Elements("PropertyTable").FirstOrDefault();
							foreach (Property vesselDetail2 in vesselDetails)
							{
								xElement4.Add(new XElement("Property", new XAttribute("Name", vesselDetail2.Description.Replace(" ", "")), new XElement("Description", vesselDetail2.Description), new XElement("Value", vesselDetail2.Value), new XElement("UOM", vesselDetail2.UOM)));
							}
						}
					}
					xDocument.Save(VesselLibraryText.Text);
				}
				Close();
			}
			catch
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show("The vessel library could not be read.");
			}
		}

		private void CancelButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)

			Close();
		}

		private void BrowseBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{

		private static void GetFluidProps(object mapVar, string varName, MMTabPageViewModel model)
		{
			string inputUri = Registry.GetValue("HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\\SOFTWARE\\AspenTech\\AMSystem\\37.0\\Dir", "Bin", "").ToString() + "ThermalFluidLibrary.xml";
			CxvMultiMapPropertyData val = (CxvMultiMapPropertyData)((mapVar is CxvMultiMapPropertyData) ? mapVar : null);
			using XmlReader xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(inputUri);

			{
				if (xmlReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element || !(xmlReader.Name == "ThermalFluid") || !(xmlReader.GetAttribute("componentname") == val.SelectedItem))
				{
					continue;
				}

		public static bool SetFluidLibraryValues(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName, MMTabPageViewModel model, string FluidLibraryVariable, string FluidLibraryActiveCCPath, string FluidLibraryValuePath, string FluidPropertiesActiveCCPath, string ThermalFluidPropertiesOptionValuePath, object FluidPropOpt_MultiMap, object Library_MultiMap)
		{
			bool result = false;
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(FluidPropertiesActiveCCPath, "value"));
			if (num.HasValue && num == 1 && pd.Name == "FluidPropOpt_MultiMap" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(ThermalFluidPropertiesOptionValuePath, "value"));
				CxvMultiMapPropertyData val = (CxvMultiMapPropertyData)((FluidPropOpt_MultiMap is CxvMultiMapPropertyData) ? FluidPropOpt_MultiMap : null);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text == "PROPERTY" && val.Value.ToString() == "FluidPropOpt_MultiMapOption_1")
				{
					GetFluidProps(Library_MultiMap, FluidLibraryVariable, model);
					result = true;
				}
			}
			int? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(FluidLibraryActiveCCPath, "value"));
			if (num2.HasValue && num2 == 1 && pd.Name == "Library_MultiMap" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(FluidLibraryValuePath, "value"));
				CxvMultiMapPropertyData val2 = (CxvMultiMapPropertyData)((Library_MultiMap is CxvMultiMapPropertyData) ? Library_MultiMap : null);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && text2 != val2.Value.ToString())
				{
					GetFluidProps(Library_MultiMap, FluidLibraryVariable, model);
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

namespace AspenTech.AspenPlus.MMForms.Blocks.BatchOp.Converters
{
	internal class GeometryVariableValueConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		private readonly string _fullFormat;

		private readonly string _displayedFormat;

		private readonly IFormatProvider _formatProvider;

		private readonly IFormatProvider _invariantProvider = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture.NumberFormat;

		public GeometryVariableValueConverter(string fullFormat, string displayedFormat, IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			_fullFormat = fullFormat;
			_displayedFormat = displayedFormat;
			_formatProvider = provider;
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			double? num = value as double?;
			if (!num.HasValue)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return num.Value.ToString(_displayedFormat, _formatProvider);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is double num)
			{
				return num.ToString(_fullFormat, _formatProvider);
			}
			string text = value as string;
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Float, _formatProvider, out var result))
			{
				return result.ToString(_fullFormat, _formatProvider);
			}
			if (double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Float, _invariantProvider, out result))
			{
				return result.ToString(_fullFormat, _formatProvider);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class SmallValueToZeroConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		[DefaultValue(1E-12)]
		public double ConvertToZeroThreshold { get; set; }

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				double? num = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(value);
				if (num.HasValue && Math.Abs(num.Value) < Math.Abs(ConvertToZeroThreshold))
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				if (num == 1E+35)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	internal class InputControlNumericEditorWidthConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)

			if (value?.ToString() != "Visible")
			{
				return 100;
			}
			return 70;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class ArrowReferenceLine : Shape
	{
		private const double ArrowWidth = 4.0;

		private const double ArrowHeight = 7.0;

		private const double ArrowLineOffset = 10.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(Dock), typeof(ArrowReferenceLine), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Dock.Right, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsFirstMarginalLineVisibleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsFirstMarginalLineVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(ArrowReferenceLine), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsSecondMarginalLineVisibleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsSecondMarginalLineVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(ArrowReferenceLine), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsFirstArrowVisibleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsFirstArrowVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(ArrowReferenceLine), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsSecondArrowVisibleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsSecondArrowVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(ArrowReferenceLine), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false));

		public Dock Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Dock)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsFirstMarginalLineVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsFirstMarginalLineVisibleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsFirstMarginalLineVisibleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsSecondMarginalLineVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsSecondMarginalLineVisibleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsSecondMarginalLineVisibleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsFirstArrowVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsFirstArrowVisibleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsFirstArrowVisibleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsSecondArrowVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsSecondArrowVisibleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsSecondArrowVisibleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override Geometry DefiningGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				double width = base.RenderSize.Width;
				double height = base.RenderSize.Height;
				if (Orientation == Dock.Left)
				{
					return CreateGeometryForInternalLeft(width, height);
				}
				if (Orientation == Dock.Right)
				{
					return CreateGeometryForInternalRight(width, height);
				}
				if (Orientation == Dock.Top)
				{
					return CreateGeometryForInternalTop(width, height);
				}
				return CreateGeometryForInternalBottom(width, height);
			}
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			return new Size((double.IsNaN(constraint.Width) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Width, (double.IsNaN(constraint.Height) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Height);
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForInternalLeft(double width, double height)
		{
			Point p = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			Point p2 = new Point(width, 0.0);
			Point p3 = new Point(0.0, height);
			Point p4 = new Point(width, height);
			Point point = new Point(10.0, 0.0);
			Point point2 = new Point(10.0, height);
			return GenerateGeometry(p, p2, p3, p4, point, point2, point, Dock.Bottom, point2, Dock.Top);
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForInternalRight(double width, double height)
		{
			Point p = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			Point p2 = new Point(width, 0.0);
			Point p3 = new Point(0.0, height);
			Point p4 = new Point(width, height);
			Point point = new Point(width - 10.0, 0.0);
			Point point2 = new Point(width - 10.0, height);
			return GenerateGeometry(p, p2, p3, p4, point, point2, point, Dock.Bottom, point2, Dock.Top);
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForInternalTop(double width, double height)
		{
			Point p = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			Point p2 = new Point(0.0, height);
			Point p3 = new Point(width, 0.0);
			Point p4 = new Point(width, height);
			Point point = new Point(0.0, 10.0);
			Point point2 = new Point(width, 10.0);
			return GenerateGeometry(p, p2, p3, p4, point, point2, point, Dock.Right, point2, Dock.Left);
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForInternalBottom(double width, double height)
		{
			Point p = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			Point p2 = new Point(0.0, height);
			Point p3 = new Point(width, 0.0);
			Point p4 = new Point(width, height);
			Point point = new Point(0.0, height - 10.0);
			Point point2 = new Point(width, height - 10.0);
			return GenerateGeometry(p, p2, p3, p4, point, point2, point, Dock.Right, point2, Dock.Left);
		}

		private Geometry GenerateGeometry(Point p11, Point p12, Point p21, Point p22, Point p31, Point p32, Point bp1, Dock orientation1, Point bp2, Dock orientation2)
		{
			PathFigure item = null;
			PathFigure item2 = null;
			PathFigure pathFigure = null;
			PathFigure item3 = null;
			PathFigure item4 = null;
			if (IsFirstMarginalLineVisible)
			{
				item = new PathFigure(p11, new PathSegment[1]
				{
					new LineSegment(p12, isStroked: true)
				}, closed: false);
			}
			if (IsSecondMarginalLineVisible)
			{
				item2 = new PathFigure(p21, new PathSegment[1]
				{
					new LineSegment(p22, isStroked: true)
				}, closed: false);
			}
			pathFigure = new PathFigure(p31, new PathSegment[1]
			{
				new LineSegment(p32, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: false);
			if (IsFirstArrowVisible)
			{
				item3 = GenerateArrowFigure(bp1, orientation1);
			}
			if (IsSecondArrowVisible)
			{
				item4 = GenerateArrowFigure(bp2, orientation2);
			}
			List<PathFigure> obj = new List<PathFigure> { item, item2, pathFigure, item3, item4 };
			List<PathFigure> list = new List<PathFigure>();
			foreach (PathFigure item5 in obj)
			{
				if (item5 != null)
				{
					list.Add(item5);
				}
			}
			return new PathGeometry(list);
		}

		private PathFigure GenerateArrowFigure(Point basePoint, Dock orientation)
		{
			Point point;
			Point point2;
			switch (orientation)
			{
			case Dock.Right:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(7.0, -2.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(7.0, 2.0);
				break;
			case Dock.Left:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-7.0, -2.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(-7.0, 2.0);
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-2.0, 7.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(2.0, 7.0);
				break;
			default:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-2.0, -7.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(2.0, -7.0);
				break;
			}
			return new PathFigure(basePoint, new PathSegment[2]
			{
				new LineSegment(point, isStroked: true),
				new LineSegment(point2, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: true);
		}
	}
